title: DTC PRODUCT & MARKET RESEARCH SPECIALIST — US E-COMMERCE
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are building a portfolio of international Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce brands, beginning with the United States market.



We are looking for an experienced DTC Product & Market Research Specialist to work directly with the Founder to identify, research, validate, and document potential product and market opportunities.



This is NOT a generic VA role.



We are also NOT looking for someone who simply finds viral products on TikTok and calls them “winning products.”



Our approach is:



Market → Problem → Customer → Product → Competition → Economics → Opportunity



Our goal is to build sustainable consumer brands, not temporary dropshipping stores.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your responsibilities will include:



• Research promising US DTC markets, categories and product opportunities

• Identify real customer problems before recommending products

• Conduct Amazon product, competitor and review research

• Research successful Shopify and DTC brands

• Analyze competitor products, pricing, offers, bundles and positioning

• Research TikTok, TikTok Shop and TikTok Creative Center

• Research Meta Ad Library

• Conduct Reddit, forum and customer-review research

• Study customer complaints, desired outcomes and failed solutions

• Identify customer buying triggers and objections

• Capture real Voice-of-Customer language

• Identify market gaps and differentiation opportunities

• Research suppliers and manufacturers

• Compare MOQ, pricing, packaging and lead times

• Conduct basic product economics analysis

• Research influencer and creator activity within potential markets

• Organize findings into clear research reports and spreadsheets



TOOLS



Experience with some of the following is preferred:



• Amazon

• Shopify

• TikTok

• TikTok Shop

• TikTok Creative Center

• Meta Ad Library

• Reddit

• Google Trends

• Similarweb

• Store Leads

• BuiltWith

• Kalodata

• Alibaba

• Google Sheets

• AI research tools



You do not need experience with every tool. However, you must be comfortable learning new research tools quickly.



WHAT WE DO NOT WANT



Please do not apply if your product research process is simply finding products with high TikTok views.



We are not looking for:



• Generic Virtual Assistants

• Copy-and-paste researchers

• Traditional dropshipping product hunters

• People who send dozens of links without analysis

• Researchers who confuse revenue with profitability

• People who recommend products without understanding the customer

• People who always say YES to an opportunity



We want someone who can investigate, think critically and challenge assumptions.



WHAT GOOD RESEARCH LOOKS LIKE



Your research should help us answer:



• Is this customer problem real?

• How painful or frequent is it?

• Are customers already spending money trying to solve it?

• What solutions are they currently using?

• What are they unhappy with?

• Who are the strongest competitors?

• What are competitors doing well?

• Where are competitors failing?

• Is there room for meaningful differentiation?

• Can the product support healthy DTC economics?

• Is there bundle or repeat-purchase potential?

• Can the product generate many strong marketing angles?

• Are there major regulatory, shipping or operational risks?

• Can this become a real consumer brand?

• What evidence could prove that we should NOT launch it?



Your research should eventually lead to one of three recommendations:



• CONTINUE VALIDATION

• MODIFY

• KILL



We value evidence over opinions.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Previous experience with Shopify/DTC product or market research is strongly preferred.



You should be:



• Highly analytical

• Excellent at online research

• Comfortable with Google Sheets

• Organized and detail-oriented

• Strong in written English

• Able to work independently

• Curious and willing to investigate deeply

• Comfortable questioning assumptions

• Willing to recommend NOT launching a product

• Able to document your evidence and sources

• Able to communicate your reasoning clearly



Quality of thinking matters more than the number of products you find.



COMPENSATION



Starting salary: $800 USD/month



Full-time: 40 hours per week.



This is intended to be a long-term position.



There will be opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation based on performance, research quality, initiative and contribution to successful product validation.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



EVIDENCE BEFORE PRODUCT



Then answer the following questions:



1. EXPERIENCE



Tell us specifically about your previous Shopify/DTC product research experience.



What products or categories did you research? What tools did you use? What happened with the products you recommended?



2. RESEARCH PROCESS



Imagine we are considering entering the US pet-home-care market.



Do NOT recommend a product.



Explain step-by-step how you would determine whether this market contains an opportunity worth pursuing.



3. KILL DECISION



Tell us about one product you researched but ultimately recommended NOT launching.



What evidence caused you to reject it?



If you have never recommended killing a product opportunity, explain why.



4. COMPETITOR RESEARCH



If we give you one successful Shopify brand, explain how you would investigate:



• Products

• Pricing

• Offers

• Target customers

• Traffic

• Advertising

• Creatives

• Reviews

• Customer complaints

• Suppliers

• Potential weaknesses



Tell us which tools you would use.



5. ECONOMICS TEST



Assume:



• Selling price: $39.99

• Landed product cost: $8

• Fulfillment + shipping: $7

• Payment processing + refund/replacement allowance: $3

• Customer acquisition cost: $17



Calculate the approximate contribution profit per first order.



Then briefly explain whether you would continue investigating this opportunity and why.



6. AVAILABILITY



Please provide:



• Current employment status

• Hours available per week

• Time zone

• Earliest starting date



7. PORTFOLIO



Share examples of previous:



• Product research

• Market research

• Competitor analysis

• Shopify/DTC research

• Research spreadsheets



Please remove confidential client information before sharing.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid practical research assignment.



The assignment will test your ability to:



• Investigate a market

• Find real customer evidence

• Analyze competitors

• Identify opportunities

• Identify risks

• Think about product economics

• Present a clear recommendation



We are not testing how many “winning products” you can find.



We are testing how you think.

title: AMS360 expert in Commercial Insurance Industry
description:
Hello,



I run Falcon Insurance of Michigan, a boutique commercial insurance brokerage focused on delivering white-glove level service to our clients.



Our business is growing tremendously right now, and we're looking for an AMS360 specialist & operations assistant to add to our team. We envision growing with this person and seeing them become our go-to AMS360 expert and one of our main operations leads!



This person must have hands-on experience with AMS360 and a solid understanding of the insurance industry, along with a passion for clean, accurate data.



The winning applicant must absolutely have the following:



Reliable high-speed Internet access

Computer with dual monitors (strongly preferred)

Headset suitable for taking phone calls

Webcam for occasional team calls and screen-share sessions



The winning applicant must absolutely have the following characteristics:



At least 2 years of hands-on experience using AMS360 daily

Comfortable navigating AMS360 customer, policy, and transaction records

Experience with policy downloads, activities/suspenses, attachments, and reporting in AMS360

Previous experience working in Insurance (extra points for commercial P&C insurance)

Understanding of commercial lines (GL, property, auto, workers comp, umbrella)

Experience with data cleanup, duplicate records, or migration projects

Very detail-oriented, and Deadline-obsessed

Fluent in English, both written and spoken (We regularly discuss complicated business insurance with our team and clients)

Able to explain AMS360 processes to non-technical team members

Tech-comfortable (Excel, Outlook, VoIP apps, carrier portals)

Comfortable building and logging details in spreadsheets

Trust-worthy, communicative and reliable



We would like this person to work full-time. It is important to note that the work hours are not limited to 8 hours per day, that is simply the minimum. Your work hours will depend on how efficiently you can work. You will be required to work normal business hours in our time zone. We're open from 9 AM - 5 PM EST every weekday.



The winning candidate will go through a 30-day trial wherein we'll further assess if you're a good fit for the company as well as if it's a good fit for you.



For our company to grow, everything must run on checklists / working procedures. You will be expected to:



Follow step-by-step procedures that already exist

Make suggestions on how to improve checklists and AMS360 workflows (when you see legitimate improvement opportunities - I may say yes or no)

Be able to grasp how the procedures are done, and be able to write an AMS360 procedure when asked to



Projects you'll be involved in include:



Auditing and cleaning up existing AMS360 data (duplicate customers, missing fields, incorrect policy info)

Entering and updating customers, policies, endorsements, and renewals in AMS360

Managing activities and suspenses so nothing falls through the cracks

Pulling and building AMS360 reports for our sales & service departments

Supporting our team with AMS360 questions and training

Helping set up and maintain AMS360 standards across the agency

Updating Spreadsheets

Other Miscellaneous tasks



Timeline:



Starting as soon as I find a qualified applicant; next few weeks would be nice, although I'm not going to rush the process. I need the right person in this position

30-day trial to begin; if we like each other we'll continue





ADDITIONAL QUESTIONS:



You will be asked to answer the following questions when submitting a proposal:



Please provide
 address for future interviews

Description of your AMS360 experience, including which modules or tasks you used most. (3 sentences)

Description of previous insurance experience. (3 sentences)

Describe a data cleanup or process improvement project you completed. (3 sentences)

Reason why you think this job is a fit for you. (3 sentences)

title: COI / ACORD Specialist for Commercial Insurance Industry
description:
Hello,



I run Falcon Insurance of Michigan, a boutique commercial insurance brokerage focused on delivering white-glove level service to our clients.



Our business is growing tremendously right now, and we're looking for a COI / ACORD specialist & operations assistant to add to our team. We envision growing with this person and seeing them become our go-to certificate expert and one of our main service leads!



This person must have hands-on experience issuing certificates of insurance and a solid understanding of commercial insurance, along with a passion for fast, accurate turnaround.



The winning applicant must absolutely have the following:



Reliable high-speed Internet access

Computer with dual monitors (strongly preferred)

Headset suitable for taking phone calls

Webcam for occasional team calls and screen-share sessions



The winning applicant must absolutely have the following characteristics:



At least 2 years of experience issuing certificates of insurance (COIs)

Strong working knowledge of ACORD forms (25, 24, 27, 28, and 125/126/140 a plus)

Able to read contracts and lease agreements and pick out the insurance requirements

Understands additional insured, waiver of subrogation, primary & non-contributory, and notice of cancellation wording

Knows when a request requires an endorsement from the carrier, not just a certificate

Previous experience working in Insurance (extra points for commercial P&C insurance)

Experience issuing certificates in an agency management system (AMS360 a big plus)

Experience with evidence of property for lenders, mortgagees, and property managers

Very detail-oriented, and Deadline-obsessed

Fluent in English, both written and spoken (We regularly discuss complicated business insurance with our clients, their vendors, and their lenders)

Friendly and great with people

Comfortable handling urgent, same-day requests from contractors and job sites

Tech-comfortable (Excel, Outlook, PDF editors, carrier portals)

Comfortable logging details in spreadsheets

Trust-worthy, communicative and reliable



We would like this person to work full-time. It is important to note that the work hours are not limited to 8 hours per day, that is simply the minimum. Your work hours will depend on how efficiently you can work. You will be required to work normal business hours in our time zone. We're open from 9 AM - 5 PM EST every weekday.



The winning candidate will go through a 30-day trial wherein we'll further assess if you're a good fit for the company as well as if it's a good fit for you.



For our company to grow, everything must run on checklists / working procedures. You will be expected to:



Follow step-by-step procedures that already exist

Make suggestions on how to improve checklists and certificate workflows (when you see legitimate improvement opportunities - I may say yes or no)

Be able to grasp how the procedures are done, and be able to write a certificate procedure when asked to



Projects you'll be involved in include:



Processing incoming certificate requests by phone,
, and our website

Issuing COIs and evidence of property forms accurately and on deadline

Reviewing contract and lease insurance requirements and flagging coverage gaps to our account managers

Requesting additional insured and waiver of subrogation endorsements from carriers when needed

Maintaining certificate holder lists and reissuing certificates at renewal

Responding to certificate compliance requests from vendors, lenders, and property managers

Updating Spreadsheets

Other Miscellaneous tasks



Timeline:



Starting as soon as I find a qualified applicant; next few weeks would be nice, although I'm not going to rush the process. I need the right person in this position

30-day trial to begin; if we like each other we'll continue



ADDITIONAL QUESTIONS:



You will be asked to answer the following questions when submitting a proposal:



Please provide
 address for future interviews

Description of your certificate of insurance experience, including your average daily volume. (3 sentences)

Description of previous insurance experience. (3 sentences)

A client's contract requires additional insured status on a primary & non-contributory basis. What do you check before issuing the certificate? (3 sentences)

Reason why you think this job is a fit for you. (3 sentences)

-2–5 years of project management experience, preferably in digital marketing or coaching industries

-Familiarity with marketing campaigns, launches, or coaching program operations

-Strong experience using project/task management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello, etc.)

-Exceptional communication and leadership skills

-Highly detail-oriented, results-driven, and comfortable in remote work environments



Bonus: Experience with funnels, email platforms (e.g., HighLevel, ActiveCampaign), and coaching client onboarding



What We Offer

-100% remote work with a collaborative, mission-driven team

-The opportunity to manage high-impact projects in coaching and personal development

-Flexible schedule with a culture of ownership and accountability

-Room for growth into strategic or leadership roles

-A team that values clarity, purpose, and transformation—in work and in life

title: Structural Engineer – Aluminium Balustrades & Louvres
description:
We are an Australian aluminium balustrade, louvre and architectural metalwork contractor seeking a capable structural engineer based in the Philippines for ongoing freelance, project-based work.



The successful applicant will personally prepare structural calculations, software analyses and draft engineering reports for:



• Aluminium balustrades and handrails

• Louvres, battens and architectural screens

• Posts, rails and supporting frames

• Brackets, plates, screws, bolts and welds

• Post-installed anchors and supporting substrates

• Maximum-span, cantilever and load tables



IMPORTANT



Only qualified engineers who can independently perform structural calculations and competently use structural-analysis or finite-element software should apply.



This is not a drafting, estimating or administrative position. You must be able to personally create and check structural models, determine loads and restraints, perform calculations, interpret results and explain your engineering methodology.



Calculations will be reviewed and certified by an Australian structural engineer where required.



REQUIRED CAPABILITIES



• Degree in civil or structural engineering

• Strong understanding of structural mechanics and load paths

• Experience with aluminium, steel or lightweight structures

• Ability to perform ULS and SLS calculations

• Member strength, deflection and local-buckling checks

• Connection, bracket, screw, bolt, weld and anchor calculations

• Ability to independently verify software results

• Professional written English and calculation-report preparation



Applicants must be proficient in relevant software such as SpaceGass, Strand7, RFEM, SAP2000, STAAD.Pro, Autodesk Robot, ANSYS, IDEA StatiCa, Mathcad, Excel or equivalent.



Australian Standards experience is preferred but not essential. Capable engineers experienced with other recognised international codes may apply. We will identify the applicable standards and arrange appropriate reference access.



Relevant standards may include AS/NZS 1170, AS/NZS 1664, AS 1288, AS 5216, AS 3600 and AS 4100.



DELIVERABLES



• Editable Word calculation report and final PDF

• Clearly stated assumptions, loads and load combinations

• Member, connection, anchor and substrate calculations

• Original editable calculation files

• Original structural-analysis or FEA model files

• Clear pass/fail summary and design recommendations

• Response to comments from the Australian reviewing engineer



Software screenshots or final results without supporting calculations and engineering interpretation will not be accepted.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



This is ongoing freelance work. A fixed fee and delivery timeframe will be agreed upon before each calculation package begins.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a brief unpaid technical assessment based on a previously completed example. It will not relate to a live project or be used for construction or commercial purposes.



TO APPLY



Please provide:



1. Your qualifications and years of experience.

2. Relevant aluminium, façade, balustrade or louvre experience.

3. The structural-analysis software you personally operate.

4. Australian or other international codes you have used.

5. One anonymised calculation report you personally prepared.

6. Confirmation that you can provide editable calculations and model files.

7. Your proposed fixed fee for a typical calculation package.

8. Your usual turnaround time.



Begin your application with “ALUMINIUM ENGINEER” to confirm that you have read the complete advertisement.



Generic applications and applicants who cannot independently perform and explain structural calculations should not apply.

title: Google Flow Video Editor Expert— Meta Ads Dropshipping
description:
Are YOU an experienced video editor who specializes in Meta Ads for ecommerce brands? Can you look at a competitor's winning ad and immediately understand why it works — the hook, the pacing, the clip choice, the emotional beat — and replicate that thinking, not just the edit?



If you answered an enthusiastic "YES," KEEP READING.



We run an international ecommerce brand selling both physical and digital products (ebooks, video courses) to English-speaking audiences in the US, UK, EU, and Australia. We're looking for a dedicated, full-time Video Editor to join our creative team and eventually grow into Head of Video Editing.



We're not chasing virality. Our goal is one thing: ads that stop the scroll and sell. Every video needs a hook strong enough to interrupt scrolling, and an edit that keeps attention high all the way through.



What you'll own:

-Sales-Focused Ad Production: Editing high-conversion Meta ads from scripts we provide — built to sell, not to go viral.

-AI Scene Generation & Recreation: Hands-on fluency with AI video tools (Google Flow, Higgsfield, and similar) to generate or recreate scenes and B-roll when what we have isn't enough — you don't wait for footage, you create it.

-Clip Curation & Sourcing: We'll provide a folder of selected B-rolls; if additional clips are needed, you source or generate them autonomously. High-quality only — traditional stock footage (Shutterstock, Envato, etc.) is strictly FORBIDDEN.

-Script-to-Screen Interpretation: We give you the hook and body copy; you d
 pacing, cuts, and visual rhythm to maximize watch-through and conversion.

-Strategic Input, Not Just Execution: We want a creative partner, not a pair of hands. You should actively propose new hooks, new formats, and new angles based on what you're seeing perform — not wait to be told what to test next.

-Constant Trend Awareness: You're the kind of editor who's already testing a new AI tool or ad format before we ask about it. Staying ahead of trends in short-form ad creative is part of the job, not an extra.

-Subtitle & Detail Precision: Clean, perfectly synced subtitles, no typos, no timing errors — this is an area where we accept zero compromise.

-Reliable, On-Time Delivery: Every deadline is a real deadline. Late deliveries disrupt the whole ad pipeline, and consistency here matters as much as editing skill.



Position Requirements:

-Full-time availability. This is not a 2-hours-a-day gig. If you're currently juggling 5–6 different clients and can't guarantee us priority and focus, please don't apply.

-Immediate or near-immediate start.

-2+ years of specific experience editing Meta Ads for ecommerce brands — physical product experience is fine, but experience with digital products (ebooks, courses, info-products) is a strong plus.

-Practical experience with AI video generation tools (Google Flow, Higgsfield, or equivalents) — this is not optional, it's core to how we produce content now.

-Fluent English — our team and all creative content are in English; you need to understand tone, nuance, and pacing at a native or near-native level.

-Strong grasp of hook, retention, and pacing — you should be able to explain why a cut works, not just execute it.

-A strategic, growth-minded approach — you think about what's next for the brand's creative, not just what's on today's task list.

-Weekend availability when needed, paid accordingly.

-Obsessive attention to detail. Subtitles, transitions, and timing must be clean. Mediocrity isn't tolerated on this team.

-Genuine passion for the craft of editing, and for staying current with where it's heading.



What We Offer:

-Performance bonuses tied to ad results, starting from month one.

-Real growth path to Head of Video Editing as the brand scales.

-Direct involvement in an international brand's creative strategy — your instincts and proposals shape what we test next.

title: Secretary for Commercial Insurance Industry
description:
Hello,



I run Falcon Insurance of Michigan, a boutique commercial insurance brokerage focused on delivering white-glove level service to our clients.



Our business is growing tremendously right now, and we’re looking for a secretary / assistant to add to our team.  We envision growing with this person and seeing them become one of our main customer service leads! 



This person must have a basic understanding of the insurance industry along with passion for providing outrageous customer service.



The winning applicant must absolutely have the following:

- Reliable high-speed Internet access

- Computer and headset suitable for taking phone calls

- Webcam for occasional team calls



The winning applicant must absolutely have the following characteristics:



- At least 2 years Experience with phone based Customer Service

- Comfortable using a CRM & sending emails

- Previous experience in working in Insurance (extra points for commercial P&C insurance)

- Experience using Voip based applications to take calls

- Very detail-oriented, and Deadline-obsessed

- Fluent in English, both written and spoken (We regularly discuss complicated business insurance with our clients on the phone)

- Friendly and great with people

- Comfortable speaking with strangers on the phone

- Comfortable dealing with upset customers

- Tech-comfortable

- Comfortable logging details in spreadsheets

- Trust-worthy, communicative and reliable 





We would like this person to work full-time. It is important to note that the work hours are not limited to 8 hours per day, that is simply the minimum. Your work hours will depend on how efficiently you can work. You will be required to work normal business hours in our time zone. We’re open from 9 am - 5 PM EST every weekday.  



The winning candidate will go through a 30-day trial wherein we’ll further assess if you’re a good fit for the company as well as if it's a good fit for you. 



For our company to grow, everything must run on checklists / working procedures. You will be expected to:

- Follow step-by-step procedures that already exist

- Make suggestions on how to improve checklists (when you see legitimate improvement opportunities - I may say yes or no)

-Be able to grasp how the procedures are done, and be able to compose a procedure when asked to.



Projects you'll be involved in include:





- Answering incoming customer inquiries (Phone calls, emails, and messages via our website) and routing them to the correct department after collecting basic information.

- Working directly to assist our sales & service departments with data validation to input any necessary information into our CRM

-Answer public and private customer questions about our products and company

- Various other customer care/outreach tasks, and administrative tasks

-Updating Spreadsheets

-Other Miscellaneous tasks





Timeline:

- Starting as soon as I find a qualified applicant; next few weeks would be nice, although I'm not going to rush the process. I need the right person in this position

- 30-day trial to begin; if we like each other we'll continue



ADDITIONAL QUESTIONS: 



You will be asked to answer the following questions when submitting a proposal:



Please provide an example of your spoken English, either via audio or a video with sound.

Description of previous phone based customer service experience. (3 sentences)

Description of previous insurance experience. (3 sentences)

Reason why you think this job is a fit for you. (3 sentences)

title: TikTok Slideshow Specialist / Content Manager – Fashion
description:
We are looking for an experienced TikTok Slideshow Specialist / Content Manager to manage and grow TikTok accounts in the fashion niche, with a strong focus on women’s shoes, boots and viral fashion products.



This is not a basic social media manager position.



We specifically need someone who already understands how to create viral TikTok slideshows / photo posts, knows what currently works on TikTok and can independently research, source, create and post content.



You should already have experience growing or managing TikTok accounts and understand how to turn trends, hooks and formats into content that gets views.



Your responsibilities:



-Research viral TikTok trends, formats and slideshow concepts

-Find winning content angles for women’s fashion and shoes

-Source images, videos and other content needed for the posts

-Create TikTok slideshows / photo posts from scratch

-Write strong hooks, text overlays and captions

-Post content consistently

-Research competitors and viral fashion accounts

-Identify trends early and adapt them to our products

-Analyze which posts perform best and create more content based on the data

-Test different hooks, formats, angles and concepts

-Independently manage the content process from research to posting

-Continuously come up with new ideas instead of waiting for instructions



The products are mainly women’s shoes, boots and viral fashion/clothing products.



You should have a strong understanding of:



-TikTok organic content

-TikTok slideshows / photo posts

-Fashion trends

-Gen Z / female-targeted content

-Viral hooks

-Trend research

-Content sourcing

-Competitor research

-Creating content that feels native to TikTok instead of looking like an advertisement



We are only looking for experienced applicants.



Please do not apply if you have never managed TikTok accounts or created slideshow content before.



When applying, send us:



Links to TikTok accounts you have personally worked on!!!!!!!

Examples of TikTok slideshow posts you created!

Your best-performing posts and how many views they received

A short explanation of what exactly you were responsible for on those accounts

How many TikTok posts/slideshows you can realistically create and post per day

Your previous experience with fashion, shoes or e-commerce brands



We are not looking for someone who simply uploads content we provide.



You are responsible for researching, sourcing, creating and posting the content yourself.



We want someone who can look at TikTok, understand what is currently going viral and quickly turn those trends into new content for our brands.



This is a long-term position for the right person.



Compensation:

Fixed monthly salary + performance-based bonuses.



The better the accounts and content perform, the more you can earn.



IMPORTANT: We receive many applications and will only review applicants who actually read the full job description.



At the start of your application, write "71" so we know you read the whole text.



Applications without 71 will be ignored.

title: Customer Service Member
description:
A prominent and growing North American facilities services organization is expanding its remote operations support and is seeking dependable, detail-oriented customer support professionals. This is a work-from-home contractor engagement supporting commercial and retail clients across Canada.



This is an independent contractor engagement, paid weekly upon receipt of invoice. The schedule is 9-hour shifts, five (5) days per week. Occasional Saturday shifts (approximately once per month) may be required. Shifts align with Eastern Standard Time: 8:00–5:00, 9:00–6:00, or 10:00–7:00 EST.



Role Overview

This is a dynamic, high-energy administrative and customer support position where every day brings new experiences and opportunities for professional growth. The role involves real-time coordination via Zoom and other internal systems to progress various tasks.



As an independent contractor working with our Customer Service Team, you’ll play a key role in maintaining the efficient flow of work orders through our systems and processes. 



Based on your skills and interests, you’ll be assigned to one of our specialized sub-teams:



•
ing Team: Monitor and manage an inbox with thousands of daily incoming
s, sort and flag urgent or high-priority
s, and collaborate with relevant teams.

• Scheduling Team: Dispatch and schedule work orders with technicians to ensure timely completion.

• Compiling Team: Handle compiling tasks, including before/after photos, invoices, sign-offs, assisting with month-end closures, and answering phones.

• Check-In/Out Team: Sign in technicians as they arrive on-site for jobs, address any issues or scope changes, and ensure smooth operations while technicians are on location.



Each sub-team works collaboratively to deliver exceptional service while minimizing bottlenecks in our workflows.



Requirements for Home Office Set Up:

• Windows PC preferred, running Windows 11

• Minimum 300 Mbps internet speed; Fibre connection strongly preferred

• Multiple monitors required (single monitor setups not suitable)

• High-quality headset with a microphone and a Reliable webcam

• Quiet, professional workspace suitable for full-day Zoom collaboration

Traits We Are Seeking:

Organization: You can handle high
 volumes, prioritize tasks, and keep everything on track.

Problem-solving: You take initiative, think independently, and easily resolve issues.

Collaborative Communicator: You work confidently with others, fostering accountability and motivation. You are a positive, self-motivated individual with clear communication.

Composed Under Pressure: You enjoy working within tight deadlines and fast-paced environments. 

Proven work history: You are looking for a long-term opportunity and have a proven track record. Experience in virtual assistance, remote administrative roles, or customer service preferred.

Strong technical Skills: You have in-depth technical skills with the ability to work in several systems and databases at one time

title: Video Editor for Meta Ads (AI + Real Footage)
description:
Who we are. A pet health brand. We sell online, direct to the customer, in Mexico and to the Spanish-speaking audience in the United States. Video is what grows the business, so this role isn't a side task: it's a core part of the team.



HOURS



We start with 5 hours a day (25 hrs/week), Monday to Friday.



The first few weeks are about settling in: getting to know our product, our customer, and our standard for what we approve, plus our workflow and our tools.



Once we see the pace and the quality are there — usually within one or two weeks — we move to 7-8 hours a day. We bring it up ourselves; you don't have to ask.



WHAT THIS JOB GIVES YOU



You always know what you need to achieve. We give you the script or the reference ad, the angle, and what we need that week. How you solve it visually is your call. We review and tell you what to change and why — never a "not feeling it" with nothing behind it.



You get paid every week, on time. Weekly payments, no delays, nothing to chase. You know exactly when your money arrives.



Your schedule is yours. Work from wherever you want, at whatever hours suit you. No fixed schedule, no sitting online waiting for messages, no explaining breaks. The only thing we look at is whether the work arrives on time and done right.



Steady hours, every week. We need ads constantly, month after month. This doesn't end after three videos. You can plan your year around these hours.



You're part of the team, not an outside vendor. We talk daily and we reply fast. If something isn't clear, say so before you start editing: we'd rather solve it in two minutes than revise the video three times. No layers, no bureaucracy, no waiting three days for someone to approve something.



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



Most of the time, you'll be working from a reference ad. We send you an ad that's already working and you adapt it to our product and our customer. It's not copying it shot for shot: it's understanding why that ad works and rebuilding it with our footage, our message, and our audience.



You'll also make variations of our own ads that are already winning. Usually changing the hook, the avatar, the voice, the gender of the speaker, the sound, or the CTA — the rest of the ad stays exactly as it is, because that's the part that already works. It's fast, repetitive work, but it demands precision: one careless change can break an ad that was performing.



And other times you'll start from a script of ours and bring it to life yourself. Here the work is visual: what the text says has to be seen on screen. If the voiceover talks about a problem, the viewer sees it; if it mentions the product, it appears. The script is the base, but the visuals are your call.



If an ad needs a clip we don't have, you find it. On social media, in stock libraries, wherever — or you generate it with AI if it doesn't exist. Part of the job is solving with what's available and knowing where to find what's missing. That said: nothing with watermarks, other brands' logos, or recognizable faces of third parties. If you're unsure whether a clip can be used, ask before you build with it.



In all cases you'll work with two kinds of material:



Real footage. Shot footage, UGC, product images, and material we send you. Editing, pacing, captions, on-screen text, and sound.



AI-generated. Realistic avatars, Spanish voiceover, and generated clips, when the ad calls for it.



Plus: syncing Spanish audio precisely and delivering to our Drive, organized and correctly named.



THE STANDARD



Clean beats flashy. With AI, the avatar has to look like a real person filmed on a real phone: consistent face, natural lighting, natural lip sync, zero artifacts. With real footage, it has to feel native to the platform, not like a TV commercial.



Consistency. Ad number forty should be as good as the first one.



TOOLS



 • CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere — required

 • Higgsfield for AI generation (avatars, clips, voice). If you don't know it, we'll teach you and we pay for it. What you do need is real experience with AI-generated video and the judgment to know when a result works and when it needs redoing.

 • Google Drive for delivery



REQUIREMENTS



 • Proven experience editing short-form ads (Meta, TikTok, or Reels)

 • Strong command of CapCut and/or Premiere: pacing, captions, on-screen text, sound

 • Previous experience with AI-generated video

 • Resourceful with material: you know where to find clips and images, and when it's faster to generate them with AI than to search for them

 • An ear for Spanish audio: syncing captions precisely and catching when a voice sounds wrong or is out of sync. You don't need to speak Spanish, but you do need to read it and notice when something is off.

 • Clear communication in English: you tell us when you start and finish your day, you reply quickly during your working hours, you ask when something isn't clear, and if you're not going to hit the agreed volume in a given week, you say so in advance

 • Reliable computer and internet



HOW TO APPLY



 1. Start your message with the word AROVEN, so we know you read this far.

 2. Send your portfolio.

 3. Also send 2-3 links to ads you edited yourself, telling us which parts were yours. If you have examples with real footage and with AI, send one of each.

 4. Pick one of those ads and explain why you think it worked well.

 5. Tell us what you think matters most in making an ad work.

 6. Tell us which AI tools you've worked with.

 7. Tell us about your current situation: whether you're working with other clients or companies right now, how many hours per week you can commit to us, and whether you could move to full-time later on.

 8. Tell us how long you lasted in your last two editing jobs and why they ended.



Applications that don't follow all eight steps won't be read. Everyone who's a fit will hear from us within the next few days with the next steps.

title: Phone Sales (US Building Products)
Expert Job Application Specialist
description:
Schedule: Full-time (Daily reporting required)

Location: Remote (MUST be available to work at least 4 hours Central Time Zone Monday-Friday)

Start Date: ASAP



Job Overview:

Are you a detail-oriented virtual assistant with exceptional organizational and writing skills? We’re seeking a reliable Job Application Specialist to manage and execute daily job applications for a Senior Data & Business Intelligence Developer and Product Manager. 



This role is perfect for a VA with experience in recruitment, resume customization, or online job applications. You will play a key role in identifying and applying to high-quality roles across Data Science, Analytics, and BI domains.



Responsibilities:

1) Apply to 30-50 job listings daily, every week.

2) Maintain a 70/30 ratio:

-- 70% Direct Applications (via company websites)

-- 30%Apply/Job Portals (e.g., LinkedIn, Indeed, Upwork)

3) Track all applications daily and submit a Google Sheet (or similar) summary of jobs applied to (including links, job titles, dates, company names).

4) Apply manually via company websites when necessary - no automation tools.

5) Customize and optimize the resume for each application based on job description and keywords.

6) Prioritize job titles such as:

-- Senior Data Scientist

-- Senior Data Analyst

-- Senior Business Intelligence Engineer/Developer

-- Product Manager



Qualifications:

- Proven experience in job applications, resume tailoring, or virtual assistance.

- Strong English writing and communication skills.

- Highly organized with great attention to detail.

- Familiarity with LinkedIn, job boards, and company career pages.

- Basic understanding of ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems) and keyword optimization is a huge plus.

- Proficiency in Google Docs/Sheets.



Tools You'll Use:

- Google Sheets or Airtable (for daily tracking)

- LinkedIn, Indeed, and other job boards

- Resume optimization tools (optional but helpful).



Reporting:

You will be required to submit a daily Google Doc or Airtable report by end of each working day listing all job applications submitted.



To Apply:

Send your resume and a brief cover letter detailing your experience with job applications or resume customization. Bonus if you include an example of a customized resume or application you’ve done.

title: Inspection Coordinator
description:
Company: We help home services companies sell and install HVAC, plumbing and electrical systems

Responsibilities:



Monitor permit tracker for "ISSUED" status permits requiring inspection scheduling

Reach out to homeowners via email, text, and phone (using OpenPhone) to gather inspection availability

Coordinate inspection scheduling with city/township/inspector offices, accounting for jurisdiction-specific rules (e.g., AM/PM windows, Tuesday-only inspectors, Friday closures, owner-initiated booking requirements)

Book confirmed inspections with the appropriate municipal inspector

Send inspection confirmation reminders to homeowners with permit numbers, inspector contact info, and on-site requirements

Update tracker and add inspection details (date, special instructions) to the Location-level NOTE section in ServiceTitan

Handle special workflows for jurisdictions where the homeowner must contact the inspector directly (e.g., Saginaw Township, Carrollton Township)

We require at least 4 hours of daily overlap Monday through Friday with a standard 9AM-5PM workday in the ET timezone (e.g. New York timezone)



Required skills:



Strong conversational English — this role involves frequent phone, text, and email communication with US-based homeowners and municipal inspectors

Previous experience with permits, inspections, or municipal/government coordination

Proven data entry experience: ability to enter large amounts of data in an accurate and efficient manner

Comfort making outbound phone calls to homeowners and city/township offices



Preferred skills:



Previous experience with a US or Canadian HVAC, plumbing or electrical contractor AND experience using ServiceTitan or HouseCall Pro. If you have experience with this, please flag this at the top of your application with the exact words: "I have worked with a contractor and with ServiceTitan" and we will expedite the interview process.

Proficiency in using tools such as Google Suite (e.g. Google Sheets, Google Docs), Slack, and OpenPhone (or similar VoIP tools)

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail to manage multiple tasks, jurisdiction-specific rules, and deadlines effectively

Customer service mindset — comfortable nudging homeowners professionally to keep inspections moving

Discretion and professionalism in handling confidential information

Reliable high-speed internet connection and a quiet environment for phone calls

Positive attitude, flexibility, and adaptability to changing priorities and tasks

This is a remote, full-time position

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
I'm the founder of a digital growth marketing company that helps mission-driven founders scale their businesses with more ease & less overwhelm - and I'm looking for a small team of highly-skilled Executive Assistants to help take over the marketing and management tasks that make a huge difference in the lives of the people that hire us.



I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company.



If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply:



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar & Email Management, etc)

You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to email & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language



-- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify

You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software



- 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram,
, Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing

You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus



- Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)

You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-)



- Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and email service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc)



ABOUT YOU:

- “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable.

- Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects.

- You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months.

- You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth

- You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving.

- Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday.

- You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources.

- You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for.



If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply.



PERKS:

I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in:

- Task & Calendar Management

- Launch/Sales Strategy Planning

- Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses)

- Social Media Management

- Digital Media Marketing (Including Email and SMS Marketing)

- Lead Generation



After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include:

- Part time work hours

- Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast)

- Starting Salary at $400-$500 USD a month ($4800-$6000 USD annual)

- Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn)



Interested? Please reply to this post with the secret keyword "APPLES" so I know you can pay attention to detail - from there, I'll let you know next steps if you qualify.

title: Staff Accountant
description:
WHAT TO EXPECT



Wonderist Agency is a full-service marketing agency that supports 1,200+ dentists around the country. We pride ourselves on ditching the old fashioned marketing model of stock photos and templated sites. We strive to tell our clients’ stories with bespoke brands, impactful photo and video shoots, and stunning website design (Here is a great example of our work: 
)



We’re a team of over 90+ passionate marketers with our headquarters nestled in sunny San Diego. We are walking distance from local hangouts, bars, and the famed Liberty Station. While many companies simply check the required boxes when it comes to culture, a well-balanced team and positive office culture has been the core of our success from the start. We are a social team at heart, and that is one constant that hasn’t changed with all the movement this economy and industry has seen. We have embraced a hybrid work model where local team members come in at least two days a week. This allows us to work from home and have flexibility, without altogether forgoing the excitement and moments of collaboration and inspiration you can only get from in-person time. Not to mention, we also genuinely enjoy spending time together and socializing.



We celebrate new ideas and prioritize a culture of trust and respect where team members can grow and take risks. Each quarter we host events under our four cultural pillars; health & wellness, personal & professional development, social good, and social. We are proud to have been named: San Diego Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in: 2018, 2021, 2022 and 2023, Inc 5000 Regionals Fastest Growing Companies in: 2021, 2022, 2024, 2025, and 2026, San Diego Business Journal’s Fastest Growing Private Companies list in 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, and 2024. Inc Best Workplaces list in: 2024, 2025, and 2026, and Inc. 5000 for the last 7 years (
)!

If you work at Wonderist, you likely enjoy a challenge, appreciate autonomy, actually care about clients, and are looking for a team that you can enjoy being part of.



JOB DESCRIPTION



The Staff Accountant keeps Wonderist’s day-to-day accounting operations accurate, current, and organized. This role owns the core transactional accounting work that keeps the books clean and month-end close on track, including accounts payable, employee reimbursements, bank feed management, AR support, recording payroll in QuickBooks Online, and the recurring close-related entries like deferred revenue and prepaid expenses.

This is a hands-on accounting seat, not a systems or management role, but it is not a purely manual one either. The right person is detail-oriented, comfortable with a recurring rhythm of daily and monthly tasks, and takes pride in accurate, well-documented books. You’ll work closely with the Controller and finance team, use AI tools to build and sharpen the processes behind your own work, and pitch in on special projects as the agency’s needs evolve.

The right candidate is organized, dependable, and genuinely enjoys the mechanics of accounting: coding transactions correctly, keeping accounts reconciled, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. Just as important, this person must be able to innovate and do. They should be comfortable identifying where AI and automation can remove manual busywork, and just as comfortable rolling up their sleeves to execute the accounting work itself.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Daily / Ongoing



●    Process accounts payable, including entering and coding vendor bills, obtaining approvals, and preparing payments on schedule.

●    Review and process employee reimbursement requests, confirming proper documentation, coding, and policy compliance before payment.

●    Manage bank feeds in QuickBooks Online, categorizing transactions, clearing exceptions, and keeping feeds current so reconciliations stay accurate.

●    Support accounts receivable, including applying payments, assisting with invoicing questions, and helping resolve unapplied payments or discrepancies.

●    Respond to internal questions about bills, reimbursements, coding, or payment status.

●    Flag unusual transactions, missing documentation, or coding issues to the Controller before they become bigger problems.



Monthly



●    Record payroll entries in QuickBooks Online, ensuring wages, taxes, benefits, and deductions are coded accurately and tie out to payroll provider reports.

●    Prepare and post deferred revenue entries, ensuring revenue is recognized in the correct period as services are delivered.

●    Prepare and post prepaid expense entries, amortizing prepaid balances on schedule and maintaining supporting schedules.

●    Reconcile assigned bank, credit card, and balance sheet accounts, researching and resolving open items promptly.

●    Support month-end close by preparing assigned journal entries and ensuring AP, AR, and payroll activity is fully recorded before close.

●    Maintain clean, organized supporting documentation for all recurring entries and reconciliations.

As Needed

●    Support special projects as assigned, which may include process cleanup, audit support, system testing, or ad hoc analysis.

●    Assist the Controller with other accounting tasks during busy periods, transitions, or process improvements.

●    Use AI tools to create, test, and improve accounting processes, templates, and checklists, reducing manual work without sacrificing accuracy.

●    Identify repetitive or error-prone tasks in AP, AR, reconciliations, or close, and propose or build a better way to do them.

Core Competencies: What you’ll bring to the role

Accounting Fundamentals

●    Solid understanding of debits, credits, and basic GAAP concepts.

●    Comfortable with accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations.

●    Understands the mechanics of accruals, prepaids, and deferred revenue.

●    Experience recording or supporting payroll journal entries.



Accuracy & Organization



●    Detail-oriented with a strong eye for catching errors before they compound.

●    Able to manage recurring monthly deadlines without missing steps.

●    Keeps clean, well-labeled supporting documentation.

●    Comfortable following (and improving) checklists and procedures.



Communication & Collaboration



●    Clear, proactive communicator who flags issues early rather than letting them sit.

●    Comfortable asking clarifying questions when something looks off.

●    Works well with the Controller and broader team, and welcomes feedback.



Innovation & Execution



●    Comfortable using AI tools to build, test, and refine accounting processes, not just to answer questions.

●    Able to spot a manual, repetitive, or error-prone task and take initiative to improve it.

●    Balances innovation with follow-through: proposes a better process, then actually builds and runs it.

●    Open to process changes as the finance function grows and improves.



Adaptability



●    Comfortable in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment.

●    Willing to pitch in on special projects outside the core role.



PERSONALITY MUSTS



Our perfect fit is someone who is a problem solver who understands the difference between “yes, and…” and “yes, but…”. You should be a hungry, scrappy personality with a positive attitude and aims to deliver. Working in the client service industry can mean going the extra mile, and we need someone who is always willing to rise to the occasion and strives to put forward accurate, dependable work. Someone who is detailed and organized, driven, and comes ready to play every day. Confidence, self-discipline, and a congenial, curious mind are things we love and admire.



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS



●    5+ years of accounting experience, including AP, AR, or bank reconciliation responsibilities. Candidates with less than 5 years of experience need not apply.

●    Solid understanding of basic accounting principles and debit/credit fundamentals.

●    Experience with QuickBooks Online is required.

●    Experience recording or supporting payroll entries.

●    Comfort with recurring monthly close tasks such as prepaids, accruals, or deferred revenue.

●    Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

●    Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

●    Ability to manage multiple recurring deadlines and maintain accuracy under time pressure.

●    Comfort working in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment.

●    Experience in using AI or automation tools to improve accounting processes.



Bonus Points for Applicants With…

(if you don’t have these but are organized and want to learn, we want to hear from you!)



●    Experience in a marketing agency, professional services business, or other recurring revenue environment.

●    Experience with 
, PandaDoc, Rippling, or similar platforms.

●    Experience supporting month-end close for a growing company.

●    Coursework or a degree in accounting or finance.

●    Interest in growing into a more senior accounting or Junior Controller-track role over time.



This is a Full-Time Salaried position. This role is structured as an EOR agreement with Rippling EOR and Wonderist Agency.

Working hours are expected to overlap with US pacific time and that is factored into the compensation range.

title: Calling All Organised Asset Management Assistants! Join Our UK Property Team — with 13th Month Bonus
description:
Hi, thanks for checking out our job posting!



If you're an organised, proactive and detail-focused person who takes pride in getting things done properly, we'd love to hear from you. At London Executive, we're building a different kind of property agency — one where homes are managed with purpose, clients are cared for, and no detail is left to chance. When you join us, you'll be part of a team that values Family, Health, Contribution, Stepping Up and Owning It, while giving you the support, coaching and development opportunities to grow. This is a long-term, fully remote role working UK hours, with paid vacation and sick leave, a 13th-month bonus, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how we operate and grow.



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING WITH US…



You'll be joining a company that's deliberately building a different kind of agency — focused on purpose, care, professionalism and high standards. You'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our operations and help improve the way we work. 



We believe growth should be part of everyday work, with coaching, regular 1:1s, feedback, development reviews, team huddles and opportunities to share learning. You'll be trusted to take ownership, contribute ideas and help make our systems, processes and client experience better. 



You'll work with a team that genuinely cares about both what we achieve and how we achieve it.



This is a long-term opportunity, not a short-term contract.

You'll have paid vacation and sick leave, plus an end-of-year 13th-month bonus.

You'll work remotely while collaborating with a team focused on delivering a high standard of service.





THE ROLE WE ARE HIRING FOR



Asset Management Assistant

As our Asset Management Assistant, you'll provide reliable, proactive administrative and operational support to the Asset Manager.



You'll help keep the moving parts of property management organised and progressing — from maintenance and repairs through to compliance, inspections, tenancy support, deposit processing and property records. This role is about more than simply completing admin tasks. We need someone who takes ownership of the details, follows things through, communicates clearly and notices when something needs attention.



Key Responsibilities:

-Support the Asset Manager with day-to-day property management administration and maintenance coordination.

-Coordinate maintenance requests, including emergencies, and communicate with tenants, landlords and contractors.

-Schedule repairs and follow up with contractors and relevant parties to ensure outstanding work progresses.

-Ensure completed repair works have been satisfactorily addressed and property records are updated.

-Support tenant and landlord queries throughout the tenancy lifecycle.

-Arrange pre-tenancy works and provide new tenants with relevant property information.

-Process and coordinate tenant deposits for release, including organising deduction lists and supporting evidence.

-Ensure eligible tenant deposits are processed and released within the required legal timeframe.

-Maintain accurate property compliance records in our CRM, including gas safety certificates, EPCs, electrical inspection certificates and other required documentation.

-Identify missing, incomplete, approaching or expired compliance documentation and escalate appropriately.

-Run property inspection due reports and coordinate inspection appointments with tenants.

-Prepare inspection templates, highlight areas requiring attention and finalise reports following Asset Manager feedback.

-Send completed inspection reports to landlords and maintain accurate inspection schedules.

-Keep taskboards, project boards and relevant operational systems up to date.

-Log support tickets, manage handovers and complete other accountability requirements.

-Help update Standard Operating Procedures and suggest improvements to processes and systems.

-Assist the Asset Manager during Property Management meetings, including taking notes.

-Answer incoming office calls, reserve keys for contractors, pass messages to the Lettings team and manage the Repairs mailbox.

-Complete required training and participate actively in weekly Script Practice, 1:1s and Monthly Development Reviews.

-Keep developing your knowledge of systems, automation and AI tools that can improve efficiency, accuracy and service delivery.





Personality Traits that best suit this role:

-Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

-Proactive — you notice what needs doing and take action.

-Detail-oriented and accurate.

-Reliable and strong on follow-through.

-Calm and professional under pressure.

-Caring and service-minded.

-Confident enough to speak up and step outside your comfort zone.

-A natural problem solver who looks for solutions rather than excuses.

-Curious and genuinely willing to learn.

-Collaborative and supportive of others.

-Comfortable taking responsibility and owning outcomes.

-Adaptable and open to new systems, technology, automation and AI.

-Trustworthy and discreet when handling confidential information.





Required Skills & Experience:

-Strong organisation and time-management skills.

-Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

-Clear and professional written and verbal communication.

-Ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines and follow-ups.

-Strong problem-solving and initiative.

-A customer-service mindset and genuine care for tenants and landlords.

-Ability to manage property-management administration across maintenance, inspections, compliance and tenancy support.

-Confidence using operational software and systems, with the ability to learn new tools quickly.

-Strong teamwork and collaboration.

-Demonstrated ownership, accountability and reliability.

-Willingness to learn and adopt appropriate AI and automation tools.

-Professional discretion and confidentiality.





Preferred Qualifications:

-Previous property management or property administration experience.

-Experience working with UK residential property.

-Experience coordinating contractors, maintenance or property inspections.

-Experience with tenancy administration or deposit processing.

-Familiarity with property-management software and digital task-management systems.

*Note: These are preferred rather than mandatory qualifications.





THE IMPORTANCE OF THIS ROLE



This role helps turn London Executive's promise of clarity, care, confidence and professional property management into the day-to-day experience of landlords and tenants.



You're the person helping ensure that the details don't fall through the cracks. Maintenance gets followed through. Compliance records stay current. Inspections happen on time. Deposits are processed accurately. Queries are progressed. Information remains organised. You'll own the coordination and follow-through, while the Asset Manager retains responsibility for higher-level judgement and decisions. 



Done well, your work gives the Asset Manager the support needed to focus on asset management while helping London Executive deliver the reliable, responsive and professional service our clients and tenants expect.





OUR STORY

London Executive was established in 1992 by the founders' parents and has grown around a focus on selling and letting some of the best homes in Central London.



The company has developed a distinctive approach to marketing and is committed to providing world-class customer service.

Today, London Executive describes itself as a different kind of agency. We aim to guide clients with confidence, protect their interests, and provide a concierge-style experience where properties are in expert hands.



We recognise that property decisions often happen during periods of change, pressure, hope or uncertainty. That's why clarity, calm, care, professionalism, empathy and creativity are central to the experience we want to create.



OUR MISSION

To redefine what it means to sell, let, and manage homes by doing things differently with purpose, creativity, and care.





WHY WE’RE A GREAT PLACE TO WORK



We believe culture is one of our greatest advantages.



We're building a high-performance team based on trust, accountability, open communication, high standards and a genuine commitment to helping one another succeed.



High performance is part of how we work. We set high standards, prepare well, embrace feedback, take initiative and focus on meaningful outcomes rather than appearances. We believe you can care deeply about people while also expecting great work — and that the two should go hand in hand.



Development isn't something that only happens during a formal review. Coaching is part of how we work. You'll have regular 1:1s, feedback, development reviews, team huddles and opportunities to share what you're learning.



Since 1992, London Executive has built its reputation around selling and letting homes in Central London, with a distinctive approach to marketing and a commitment to world-class customer service. We also invest time and money into training and development because we want our team to become better and more professional people.



THE VALUES WE STAND BY

1. Family — Family First — We support one another with mutual respect, care, open communication and a shared commitment to being a great team.

2. Health — Without our health, everything else is irrelevant — We recognise that protecting our health, energy, boundaries and wellbeing helps us perform sustainably.

3. Contribution — Add Value — We aim to make things better, not simply busier, and leave our roles, systems and processes stronger than we found them.

4. Stepping Up — Step Outside Your Comfort Zone — We speak up, take initiative, handle difficult situations and act when something needs to move forward.

5. Owning It — Responsibility & Ownership — We take responsibility for our actions and outcomes, follow through on commitments and look for solutions rather than excuses.



PAY, HOURS & BENEFITS

Pay: $750–$800 USD per calendar month

Start: ASAP

Employment: Long-term

Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM UK Time

Availability: At least 40 hours per week

Location: Fully remote

Payment: Biweekly during the first month, then monthly thereafter

Paid Time Off: Paid vacation and sick leave

Bonus: End-of-year 13th-month bonus

Growth: Genuine career growth and development opportunities

Impact: Opportunity to make a significant impact on our operations and grow the business

Culture: Collaborative and innovative work environment



NOW THE IMPORTANT PART — HOW YOU CAN APPLY:

The first step to joining our team is to complete a short questionnaire. It will take about 25–35 minutes and needs to be completed in one sitting. When you're ready, click this link to get started: 
 



Please do not send a CV/resume or cover letter unless specifically requested.



We are looking for someone who genuinely wants a long-term opportunity, is comfortable working UK hours, and is excited about taking ownership and contributing to a growing business.



Response Timeline: By 25th September

title: EXECUTIVE & ADMINISTRATIVE ASSISTANT TO THE FOUNDER (US Eastern hours)
description:
READ THIS FIRST

This is a front-door-and-right-hand role. Two things matter most: you answer people quickly (clients, prospective clients, candidates), and you keep the founder's working day running — her calendar, her calls, her follow-ups. If you're the person who hears the ping and replies, learns a new system in a week, and would rather jump in and help than wait to be asked, this is for you. If you prefer quiet, deep project work without interruptions, it isn't — and that's okay.

 

ABOUT US

We are a small, warm, high-end nanny agency serving families in Westchester, Manhattan, Connecticut, New Jersey, and the Hamptons. We run on our own custom platform (you'll be trained — quick learners thrive here). Our team is friendly, remote, and mostly based in the Philippines. Our clients expect a polished, personal experience, and our reputation is built on being responsive and kind.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

The front door comes first, always: the shared inbox and our client inquiries. Everything else fits around it — and a good assistant knows how to prioritize without being told.

 

- The inbox: every
 from clients, prospective clients, and candidates — answered, routed to the right teammate, or flagged to the founder right away if it needs her. Anything time-sensitive (a booking request, a client asking for a document, a new inquiry) is handled the moment you see it, not later. First replies within the hour.

- Client inquiries: our Incoming tab — follow up with every open inquiry on schedule until it's closed. No one slips through.

- The founder's calendar: schedule and confirm her client calls, reschedule when a client needs to move, send reminders, and protect her day so she's never double-booked. You'll work with her directly on this.

- Job posts to our board the same day a new search comes in.

- Little Minders booking requests: handle member booking requests as they come in and keep the sitter calendar moving.

- Candidate support: chasing references 
, text, follow up on a schedule), auditing candidate profiles so they're complete and correct, searching our database and job platforms for candidates who fit open positions, and running short intro calls with candidates when needed.

- Day-to-day support for the founder and coordination between our recruiter and placement coordinator — a bit of everything, wherever the day needs you.

 

HOURS

Monday–Friday, 9:00 am – 6:00 pm US Eastern (that's evening/night in the Philippines). The role exists to cover the hours our clients write to us and the founder works. Breaks whenever you need them — just make sure nothing is sitting unanswered while you're away.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- A strong work ethic — you take ownership and you finish things

- A quick learner — comfortable picking up a custom platform and our way of doing things fast

- Responsiveness as a personality trait, not a policy

- Warm, clear written English — you'll write to families every day

- Organized, but never at the expense of speed; you ask when unsure rather than wait

- Flexible and willing — happy to help with whatever the day needs

- Reliable, and honest about what's done and what isn't

- At least 3 years as an executive assistant or in a customer-facing, inbox-heavy role (agency, hospitality, support) — this is a senior seat, not a first job

 

PAY

PHP 60,000–80,000 per month depending on experience, paid twice monthly via Wise. The rate reflects US Eastern hours. 13th-month pay for long-term team members. Full-time, long-term. Paid trial before hiring (see below).

 

This is not an entry-level role. We're looking for someone with at least 3 years of experience supporting a founder, executive, or busy team — owning an inbox and a calendar, not just assisting with them.

 

HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE FOLLOW EXACTLY

Your application must start with the word FRONTDOOR on its own line, then answer three things in a few sentences each:

1. Tell us about a job where you were responsible for an inbox, a calendar, or responding to customers. What was your typical response time, and how did you keep it?

2. A client
s at 9:05 am asking to see our agreement before d
 to work with us. You're not sure where the document is. What do you do in the next ten minutes?

3. Your expected monthly salary.

Applications that don't start with FRONTDOOR won't be read. We reply to every application that does, within two business days — and we notice how quickly you reply back.
