title: Remote Marketing & CRM Operations
description:
Are you a detail-oriented, tech-savvy Virtual Professional who enjoys working behind the scenes to keep systems clean, connected, and reliable?



We’re looking for a proactive VP of Backend Operations & CRM Systems to support a high-performing service business by maintaining accurate data flow across HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow. This role is ideal for someone who is organized, systems-minded, comfortable troubleshooting platform issues, and able to help leadership pull accurate reports on leads, appointments, and revenue by source.



This is not a strategy role. The focus is on backend operations, data accuracy, CRM cleanup, reporting support, and workflow efficiency.



What You’ll Do



You’ll support day-to-day backend operations by helping ensure the client’s tools are properly set up, connected, and producing clean, reliable data.



CRM, Reporting & Data Management

• Review and clean up HubSpot data to ensure leads, appointments, deals, and revenue are accurately tracked.

• Help build and maintain HubSpot reports that leadership can easily pull and trust.

• Check that data from CallRail, web forms, Vendo, and Arrivy maps correctly into HubSpot.

• Identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent lead source data and help correct it.

• Maintain clean deal records, contact records, and source attribution where needed.



CallRail, RingCentral & Source Attribution Support

• Review CallRail tracking numbers and confirm they are assigned to the correct lead sources, such as Google Ads, LSA, organic, referral, or outbound campaigns.

• Help clean up source attribution issues where outbound calls are incorrectly tagged under sales reps rather than the proper source categories.

• Support workflow improvements between CallRail and RingCentral to reduce platform-switching friction for the call center team.

• Document issues, patterns, and recommended fixes clearly.



Platform & Workflow Support

• Review the flow of information from HubSpot to Arrivy, Vendo, and back to HubSpot.

• Help troubleshoot minor system issues and coordinate with platform support teams when needed.

• Assist with routine Webflow content updates and minor website maintenance.

• Clearly document processes, updates, and recurring tasks so the team has reliable SOPs.



Admin & Communication Support

• Communicate clearly with the client, team members, and vendor/platform support teams.

• Provide regular updates on progress, blockers, and completed tasks.

• Use AI tools responsibly to improve documentation, reporting, and written communication.

• Maintain organized records, task lists, and process guides.



Who We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and comfortable working across multiple systems. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be confident in learning platforms, checking integrations, and spotting data inconsistencies.



You may be a great fit if you:



• Have strong English communication skills, especially in written updates and documentation.

• Are detail-oriented and can spot inconsistencies in data, reports, workflows, and CRM records.

• Are tech-savvy and comfortable learning tools like HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow.

• Have experience with CRM management, reporting, lead tracking, or sales operations support.

• Can follow instructions carefully while also thinking ahead and identifying potential issues.

• Are proactive, resourceful, and willing to explore possible solutions before escalating.

• Can communicate blockers clearly and ask thoughtful questions when context is missing.

• Are comfortable working in a backend support role with limited customer-facing responsibilities.

• Can maintain confidentiality when handling client, customer, sales, and revenue-related data.



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



• HubSpot CRM, pipelines, properties, workflows, reports, or dashboards

• CallRail tracking numbers, call source attribution, or lead source cleanup

• RingCentral or other VoIP/call center platforms

• Webflow content updates or website maintenance

• Sales operations, marketing operations, or CRM administration

• Process documentation, SOP creation, or backend operations support

• Google Sheets, Excel, or reporting/data cleanup tasks



Tech & Infrastructure Requirements: To ensure a smooth and efficient remote work experience, applicants must have:

• Intel i5 10th Gen or AMD Ryzen 5 (or higher)

• Minimum 8GB RAM

• Device (laptop or PC) must be less than 3 years old

• Stable internet: 50–100 Mbps, with a backup connection

• Quality webcam, mic, and headset

Screenshots of your device specs and an internet speed test will be required upon application.



Why You’ll Love Working with Claud?

• Paid holidays & PTO

• HMO (after 1st year)

• Family Medical Incentive

• PAG-IBIG & referral incentives

• Weekends off

• Free learning sessions & fun company events

• Supportive, growth-driven remote community



Let's Get to Know You: Please include your answers to the following in your application :

3. What challenges do you foresee in this role?



Don’t just look for a job - build a meaningful career filled with freedom, balance, and the support you deserve.



Apply today!

title: Senior Support Engineer
description:
THE SHORT VERSION



We need a senior engineer who is the last technical stop before the CIO.



Right now that last stop is the CIO, and that is the problem we are hiring to

fix. You would own escalations from our junior technicians, take directed work

from management, and carry your own tickets and projects through to sign-off.

You will be trusted to make the call and defend it, not to hand it back up the

chain.



If you are senior, you have run a real multi-client queue, and you are tired of

being the person who escalates rather than the person who d
, read on.





WHO WE ARE



CasCom is a managed technology services provider in Yellowknife, Northwest

Territories. We have been doing this since 1996. Our clients are federal,

territorial and Indigenous governments, mining and resource companies,

construction firms, financial institutions, hotels and remote industrial camps

across the Northwest Territories, Nunavut and Yukon.



Many of our sites sit at the end of a satellite link in a community with no

local IT staff and nobody available to read a screen back to you. In winter

there is no road in. That constraint shapes how we work. We document, we

verify, and we do not guess on somebody else's production system.





WHAT THE WORK ACTUALLY LOOKS LIKE



These are real problems from recent months, with client names removed. If

reading them makes you want to start typing, you are the person we want.



  - An RMM-deployed installer succeeds across most of a fleet and fails on a

    stubborn subset with "Object reference not set to an instance of an

    object." Nothing in the logs separates the failures from the successes.



  - A user passes every Microsoft 365 policy and licensing check for a feature

    and still gets told they do not have permission. Policy propagation, client

    version and organizer scoping are all live possibilities.



  - A PowerShell script that ran fine last month now dies at sign-in because

    two Microsoft modules loaded in the same session disagree about which

    authentication assembly to use.



  - An EDR detection fires on a client server at 2 AM. You d
 whether it is

    noise or an i
, you start the clock on notification obligations, and

    you write it up so it holds up later.



  - A mailbox starts behaving strangely. You find the forwarding rule, work out

    what was taken and when, and explain it to a client executive who does not

    want a lecture on OAuth.



  - A hotel property's guest network saturates because IPTV shares a node with

    guest traffic. The fix is per VLAN bandwidth control on the edge firewall.



  - Guest devices at a property drop when they roam between access points. The

    answer is somewhere across VLAN tagging, controller configuration and RF

    coverage, and not cleanly inside any one of them.



  - Mail from a client domain starts failing authentication after a vendor

    changes its sending service, and you sort out SPF, DKIM and DMARC alignment

    before the client's invoices stop arriving.



  - A delegated admin relationship to a client tenant lapses and your

    multi-tenant management portal quietly stops seeing that tenant.



Alongside that, you will carry project work through to completion: tenant

migrations, endpoint standardization, security tooling rollouts, and the

documentation that makes the next person's job possible.





WHAT WE RUN



  - Microsoft 365 and Entra ID in a multi-tenant environment, GDAP delegated

    administration, Conditional Access, Intune

  - Datto RMM and Datto EDR

  - Kaseya 365 User and Endpoint, RocketCyber, SaaS Alerts, Kaseya SIEM

  - Autotask PSA and IT Glue

  - CIPP for multi-tenant Microsoft 365 management

  - Enterprise edge firewall and UTM gateway platforms

  - Ubiquiti and Cambium wireless and network infrastructure

  - PowerShell and Microsoft Graph



You will not have used all of it, and we do not expect you to. Tell us honestly

what you have and have not touched. We would rather teach a strong engineer our

tools than hand our escalation queue to somebody who memorised a product list.





WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



Required:



  - Five or more years in managed services or another multi-client

    environment. This is not a single-employer internal IT role and it does

    not behave like one.

  - Real Microsoft 365 and Entra ID depth. Not only user administration.

    Conditional Access, licensing, mail flow, and reading sign-in logs through

    to a conclusion.

  - PowerShell you write, not only PowerShell you run.

  - Working security fundamentals. You can triage a detection, recognise a

    compromised mailbox, find a malicious inbox rule, and explain what you

    found to somebody non-technical without frightening them or patronising

    them.

  - Written English strong enough that your ticket notes and client updates go

    out without editing. Half of this job is writing.

  - You finish things. You close the loop. You update the ticket before you go

    to bed.



Counts for a lot:



  - Hands-on Datto RMM, Datto EDR, Autotask, IT Glue or CIPP experience.

  - Ubiquiti and Cambium wireless. Controller administration, point to point

    links, guest network design and RF troubleshooting.

  - Firewall, VLAN and routing work on real edge devices.

  - Backup and disaster recovery, including a restore you actually performed.

  - I
 response against a framework such as NIST 800-61, and comfort

    writing the i
 report afterwards.

  - A documentation habit. IT Glue articles, SOPs, runbooks.

  - Automation and integration work against vendor APIs.





THE HONEST PARTS



We would rather tell you these now than after three rounds of interviews.



  - Remote only, working from the Philippines. The role does not relocate.

  - Our helpdesk runs Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM Mountain Time in Canada,

    which falls overnight in the Philippines. We need genuine overlap and we

    need you to be honest about what you can sustain over years rather than

    weeks.

  - You will be trusted quickly with client production systems and with

    administrative access across our managed base. Background and reference

    checks apply, and so does a confidentiality agreement.

  - Some weeks are i
 weeks. They are not the normal week, but they

    happen, and when they happen everyone works.

  - Our clients include governments and regulated organizations, so discretion

    is part of the job description rather than a bonus.





WHY THIS ONE IS WORTH YOUR TIME



You will see the whole stack rather than one slice of it. You will make

decisions instead of routing them. The environments are genuinely unusual:

satellite links, mine sites, Arctic communities, and organizations where the

nearest alternative technician is a flight away. Nobody here will ask you to

read from a script.





HOW TO APPLY



Send your CV to 
 with "Senior Systems Engineer" in the

subject line, and answer three questions in the body. Short answers are fine.

We care more about how you reason than about a tidy result, and the answers

matter more to us than the CV does.



  1. Tell us about one piece of work you owned from the first ticket through to

     sign-off while you were still carrying a live queue. What nearly derailed

     it, and what did you do about it?



  2. A user cannot do something in Microsoft 365. Every policy and licensing

     check you run says they should be able to. The client is asking for an

     update. Where do you go next?



  3. Your EDR fires on a client server outside business hours. What do you do

     in the first thirty minutes, and what tips it from noise into a declared

     i
?



Every application is read by a person, and we will come back to you either way.





CasCom Ltd.

Enabling the North

title: Real Estate Acquisition Cold Caller
description:
FEMALE Acquisitions Cold Caller — Real Estate Investing Company

This position is open to FEMALE only !



AVAILABILITY

Full-time, 40 hours per week

Must work US Central Standard Time

8 hours a day, Monday through Friday

REQUIREMENTS

Noise-cancelling headset

Your own computer or laptop

High-speed, stable internet (we will ask for a speed test)

A quiet place to take calls

ABOUT THIS ROLE



We buy houses directly from owners. You will be the first person from our company they ever speak to. Your job is to reach the owner, find out whether selling is something they are open to, and understand what is actually going on in their situation.



Most of your day is spent on a small, researched list rather than a raw dump of numbers. Some of the properties we look at have complications behind them — an owner who has passed away, unclear title, back taxes. Plenty of them are perfectly straightforward. Either way, what you are listening for is an owner who wants to sell, and the reason behind it.



COLD CALLING EXPERIENCE REQUIRED — BUT THIS IS NOT A MASS-DIALING ROLE



Please read this part carefully before you apply.



You need real cold calling experience. We are not teaching somebody to pick up a phone for the first time, and this is not a warm-lead or inbound seat.



What we are not is a volume shop. We do not want 300 dials a day read off a script. If your last three jobs were high-volume outbound where success meant hitting a dial count, this role will feel slow to you and you will not enjoy it.



We measure real conversations and qualified leads passed to acquisitions — not dials. A single call here can run twenty minutes because you are actually listening to somebody explain their situation. That has to be a conversation you can hold.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

1–2 years of cold calling experience. This is required, not preferred. If you have five or more years of pure mass dialing, you are likely not the fit.

A real estate background is required. You should already be comfortable talking to a homeowner about their property.

A plus: probate, surplus funds, unclaimed funds, excess proceeds, or tax foreclosure experience.

Willing to read an obituary or work out a family tree when a record calls for it. Good if you have done it before, but we will train this.

Excellent spoken English, and the confidence to hold a conversation that is not scripted.

Outgoing and personable. You build rapport quickly without being pushy.

Self-motivated. You will work independently on US Central hours.

Comfortable in a CRM, and disciplined about logging every attempt accurately.

Bonus: skip tracing experience, REISift (Now is Datasift)



TRAINING AND EXPECTATIONS



Expect around 30 days to get fully up to speed on our vocabulary and our process. We will train you past the script. We are not looking for plug-and-play, and we do not hire people and let them go a week later. In return, we expect you to start on time, hit your daily numbers, and tell us early when something is not working.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application to 
 using the exact subject line “HTX-ONLPH- PROSPECT as a subject . Applications with the wrong subject line will not be read.



Include all three of the following:



1. Your resume.

2. A DISC personality test. Take a fresh one at 
/free-disc-test/ and send the full result, including both your natural and your adapted style.

3. A one-minute video of yourself telling us about your proudest accomplishment. Speak naturally. Do not read from a script.

COMPENSATION:



$5 -per month base for 30-40 hours per week, plus 2.5% commission on every closed deal.

description:
FEMALE Acquisitions Cold Caller — Real Estate Investing Company

This position is open to FEMALE only !



AVAILABILITY

Full-time, 40 hours per week

Must work US Central Standard Time

8 hours a day, Monday through Friday

REQUIREMENTS

Noise-cancelling headset

Your own computer or laptop

High-speed, stable internet (we will ask for a speed test)

ABOUT THIS ROLE



We buy houses directly from owners. You will be the first person from our company they ever speak to. Your job is to reach the owner, find out whether selling is something they are open to, and understand what is actually going on in their situation.



Most of your day is spent on a small, researched list rather than a raw dump of numbers. Some of the properties we look at have complications behind them — an owner who has passed away, unclear title, back taxes. Plenty of them are perfectly straightforward. Either way, what you are listening for is an owner who wants to sell, and the reason behind it.



COLD CALLING EXPERIENCE REQUIRED — BUT THIS IS NOT A MASS-DIALING ROLE



Please read this part carefully before you apply.



You need real cold calling experience. We are not teaching somebody to pick up a phone for the first time, and this is not a warm-lead or inbound seat.



What we are not is a volume shop. We do not want 300 dials a day read off a script. If your last three jobs were high-volume outbound where success meant hitting a dial count, this role will feel slow to you and you will not enjoy it.



We measure real conversations and qualified leads passed to acquisitions — not dials. A single call here can run twenty minutes because you are actually listening to somebody explain their situation. That has to be a conversation you can hold.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

1–2 years of cold calling experience. This is required, not preferred. If you have five or more years of pure mass dialing, you are likely not the fit.

A real estate background is required. You should already be comfortable talking to a homeowner about their property.

A plus: probate, surplus funds, unclaimed funds, excess proceeds, or tax foreclosure experience.

Willing to read an obituary or work out a family tree when a record calls for it. Good if you have done it before, but we will train this.

Excellent spoken English, and the confidence to hold a conversation that is not scripted.

title: Experienced Video Editor for YouTube & Short-Form Videos
description:
I’m looking for an experienced, creative, and detail-oriented Video Editor to join my team and help me create polished YouTube videos and short-form content for writers.



I’m a literary agent and writing educator, and I create practical writing advice for authors. I’m looking for someone who can take professionally recorded footage and turn it into engaging, polished videos for YouTube and TikTok.



I’m easy to work with, provide clear direction and feedback, and really value a collaborative working relationship. I’m looking for an editor who can bring their own experience and judgment to the process and help make each video as strong as it can be.



About the role



You’ll primarily be editing:

• YouTube videos, approximately 10–15 minutes

• YouTube Shorts

• TikTok videos

• Talking-head educational content

• Writing and craft education content

• On-screen text, examples, graphics, B-roll, and occasional visual effects



The content is educational rather than entertainment-focused, so clarity, pacing, visual appeal, and professionalism are especially important.



What I’m looking for



I’m looking for someone with solid professional experience who is comfortable making creative decisions and working independently.



Ideally, you:

• Have 3+ years of professional video editing experience

• Have experience editing talking-head YouTube content

• Have experience creating short-form content for social media

• Have a strong sense of pacing and timing

• Have good visual and typography instincts

• Understand text placement, contrast, readability, and composition

• Use B-roll, graphics, music, and effects thoughtfully

• Have excellent attention to detail

• Can follow an established brand style while also bringing your own creative judgment

• Communicate clearly and professionally

• Are comfortable receiving feedback and incorporating it into future edits

• Take pride in delivering work that is polished and ready to publish



A big part of what I’m looking for: good visual judgment.



One of the things I value most in an editor is the ability to look at the finished video from the viewer’s perspective.

For example, you might notice that:

• Text could be easier to read against a particular background

• A graphic needs a small adjustment to feel more balanced

• A cut could be tightened to improve the pacing

• A section would benefit from a little more visual variety

• An on-screen example could appear at a slightly different moment

• Something that looked fine during the initial edit could be improved before the final version



I don’t expect you to get everything perfect on the first pass. I do appreciate an editor who is thoughtful about the finished product and who can take feedback and apply it going forward.



My goal is to give you enough direction to understand what I’m looking for while also giving you room to use your experience and creativity.



Software

You should be highly proficient in your primary editing software. Please let me know which software you use and how long you’ve been using it. Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, Canva, or similar tools is a plus.



What it’s like to work with me



I value:

• Clear communication

• Reasonable turnaround times

• A collaborative approach

• Attention to detail

• Reliability

• Openness to feedback

• Someone who can eventually work independently and anticipate what will make the content stronger



I’m not looking for someone who needs to be given instructions for every tiny detail. At the same time, I want you to feel comfortable asking questions when something isn’t clear.



The goal is to develop a working relationship where, over time, you become very familiar with my style and can confidently make many of those decisions yourself.



To apply



Please include:

1. A link to your portfolio

2. 2–3 examples of YouTube talking-head videos you’ve edited

3. 2–3 examples of short-form videos you’ve edited

4. How many years you’ve been professionally editing

5. What editing software you use

6. Your hourly rate or rate per video

7. Your typical turnaround time for a 10–15 minute YouTube video

8. Your availability and approximate number of hours you can work per week

9. A brief explanation of how you review your work before delivering a finished video



Please don’t send a generic application. I’d love to hear a little about your experience with talking-head educational content and the kind of editing work you most enjoy.



If you could travel to another planet, what three things would you bring?



I’m looking for someone who would like to build a long-term working relationship with me as my channel grows.



If you’re an experienced editor with a good eye, strong attention to detail, and a thoughtful approach to your work, I’d love to see your portfolio!

About the Schedule



The shift is 12:00 AM to 8:00 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday. That's 9am–5pm in Vancouver, Canada, where we're based.

This is a permanent work from home and graveyard schedule, not a rotating one. If that doesn't work for your life, please don't apply — we'd rather you skip this than quit in two months.



!! About Call Hero



Call Hero is a fast-growing SaaS company based in Canada. We build AI-powered communication tools that help healthcare clinics improve the way they manage patient calls, appointments, and front desk operations.



Our customers include physical therapy clinics, chiropractic offices, dental practices, and other healthcare providers. Our mission is simple: help clinics deliver a better patient experience while increasing bookings and reducing missed opportunities.



!! The Role



You are not cold calling. You'll work warm inbound: people who have booked a demo, started a trial, missed a scheduled call, or gone quiet.



Your job is to get on the phone with a clinic owner, understand how their practice actually runs, show them what we do, and close them. You will spend at least 4 hours a day on the phone. The rest is CRM notes, follow-up, and prep.



This is NOT a virtual assistant job. No admin, data entry, design, or social media. If you don't genuinely enjoy talking to people on the phone, this role will make you miserable and we'd both regret it.



??What You'll Do



> Run scheduled demo calls with clinic owners in Canada, the US, and Australia

> Follow up with trial users and no-shows until you get a decision either way

> Handle objections about price, timing, and existing phone systems

> Keep your pipeline clean in our CRM — every call logged, every next step dated

> Hit a monthly closed-deal target



?? What We're Looking For



> At least 2 years of phone sales experience carrying a real quota. Customer support alone is not enough.

> Experience with North American customers, preferably in a BPO or similar environment

> Excellent, natural spoken English with a neutral or North American accent. You'll be speaking with clinic owners who need to feel they're talking to a colleague.

> Proven graveyard shift experience — tell us how long you did it

> Comfortable handling objections and closing, not just presenting

> A real headset and stable wired internet (25 Mbps+)

> Coachable. We record calls and review them together weekly.



!! Nice to Have



> Any healthcare background — our customers are clinicians, and speaking their language helps enormously

> Experience selling software or a subscription product

> Any background where you've been trained on how you sound



** Compensation

Php80,000–Php100,000 per month guaranteed base depending on experience, plus uncapped commission on every deal you close.



On-target earnings are Php80,000–Php150,000; the top of that range is what a strong closer actually earns hitting target, not a ceiling.



You'll also receive paid training, weekly coaching on your recorded calls, and a long-term full-time seat on a small team where you'll talk to the founder directly.



HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW THIS EXACTLY (Send all completed application requirements to: 



Applications missing any of these five items will not be opened. This is not a soft preference.



1. Subject Line



Write the name of the city we are based in, then a dash, then the minimum number of hours per day you'd spend on the phone in this role. Both are stated above.



Format example: Toronto - 6



2. Send the Link to Your 2-Minute Audio Recording



Please send us the link to your 2-minute audio recording covering the 3 parts below. You can use Loom, Google Drive, or an unlisted YouTube video. (Three parts, about 2 minutes total)

title: Performance Video Ad Editor | Winners + Performance Bonuses
description:
Performance Video Ad Editor | Winners + Performance Bonuses



We’re looking for a video ad editor who wants to make winners, not just good-looking videos.



If your main focus is transitions, effects and making videos look polished, please don't apply.



We need someone who understands why an ad works. Someone who thinks about the hook, pacing, retention, message, audience and angle, and can look at performance data, understand what worked and use those learnings to make the next ad better.



We launched our brand on April 18th and scaled to around $400K/month within our first few months. Our next target is much bigger: $100K days.



Creative is the biggest lever to get us there, and that is exactly why we are hiring.



------------------------------



- What it is like to work with us -



You’ll work directly with the founders and get access to a brand with a huge amount of existing creative data, winning ads, scripts, customer research and proven angles.



This is not a role where we send you footage, you edit it and we speak again next week. We constantly look at what is working inside the ad account, why it is working, what is dying and what we should make next.



Every week we look at creative performance together. You’ll see exactly how your ads perform and we’ll use that data to d
 what to iterate on next. The feedback loop is short and you will learn fast.



You’ll mainly be creating short-form video ads for Meta. As we grow, there will also be opportunities to work on longer-form ads, YouTube creatives and VSL-style content.



If you prove that you can do more than execute briefs, this can grow into a creative strategist role.



------------------------------



- Who we are looking for -



There are three things we care about.



First, you need to be hungry to make winning ads. We want someone who gets excited when an ad starts scaling and immediately thinks: “How do we beat it?”



Second, you need to understand performance creative. An ad isn’t good because it has clean transitions or fancy editing. It is good because it gets the right person to stop, watch, believe and buy.



You should be thinking about the hook, angle, awareness level, pacing, psychology, visuals and message, and you should be able to explain why you made those choices.



Third, you need to speak fluent English. Our ads are made for English-speaking markets and you need to understand the small details in scripts, hooks and customer language.



------------------------------



- Experience matters, hunger matters more -



If you have experience and proven winners, great. We want to see them.



But if you don’t have a massive track record yet and you are extremely hungry to learn, understand the basics of direct response and already know how to edit, we want to see your Loom too.



We would rather work with someone who has less experience but is obsessed with getting better than someone with a great résumé who has stopped learning.



Just be honest about where you are.



Don’t make up results. Don’t claim an ad was a winner if you can’t prove it. If you’re junior, tell us you’re junior. Show us what you do know, how you think and why you’re hungry to get better.



Motivation > experience.



If you’re an EcomTalent graduate, that’s +10 points. Make sure to mention it.



------------------------------



- What you’ll actually do -



You’ll turn scripts, briefs and raw assets into performance-focused video ads. You’ll create and test different hooks and iterations, study existing winners and losers and use that data to improve future creatives.



We expect you to bring your own brain to the work. If you see a better way to execute a script, say it. If you think an angle is weak, challenge it. If you spot something in a winning ad that we should iterate on, bring it to us.



------------------------------



- Compensation -



We want to be upfront about this. The base pay for this role will not be huge.



The compensation is built around a heavy performance-based bonus structure. The better your ads perform, the more you earn.



There is no fixed ceiling on the bonuses. If you consistently create ads that make us serious money, we want you making serious money too.



We start with a paid test project. If it’s a fit, we want this to become a long-term/full-time position.



There is also a real path beyond editing. If you prove that you understand why ads work and can consistently bring your own ideas, you can grow into creative strategy and take on much more responsibility.



------------------------------



- How to apply -



Send us a Loom video of no more than 8 minutes.



Tell us:



1. Who you are, your background and your experience with performance video ads.



2. Why you want this role and why you want to become great at performance creative.



3. Show us the best-performing ad you have ever made and break it down.



If you claim the ad was a winner, we need to see proof. Show us the actual ad spend behind it and, where available, the performance data from the ad account.



We don’t want to see an ad that simply looks good or that someone told you was a winner. If you claim results, prove them.



Then explain why you think it worked. Talk us through the hook, angle, audience, pacing, visuals, messaging and the decisions you made.



If you don’t have a proven winner yet, that’s fine. Don’t pretend you do. Show us the best ad you’ve made and explain the thinking behind it, which direct-response principles you used, what you would test next and what you think could make the ad better.



If your thinking is strong and your hunger is obvious, we still want to see your application.



Applications without a Loom will not be considered.



We’re not looking for someone who just wants another editing client. We want someone who wants to become extremely good at making ads that sell and wants their income and responsibility to grow with their ability.



If that sounds like you, send the Loom.

title: Junior Full Stack Developer
description:

title: Meta Ads Static Creative Designer and Campaign Setup VA
description:

Design static image creatives for Meta ads in square and vertical sizes. Before and after images, offer graphics, testimonial graphics, and text overlay ads.

Spin winning creatives into 4 to 6 test variations per angle.

A strong design eye. Your work should look modern, not like a 2015 template.

Fluent in Canva plus at least one of Photoshop, Figma, or Illustrator.

Real hands on time inside Meta Ads Manager and Business Manager. You should know what an ad set is without Googling it.

You get that a

Read this part carefully. Applications that skip a step get deleted.

2. Send a portfolio link or attach 3 to 5 static ad creatives you personally designed.
 or Instagram ads specifically. Not logos, not flyers, not websites.

4. Tell us your available hours in Philippine time.

title: E-commerce Video Editor (Meta Ads Specialist)
description:
Are YOU an experienced video editor who specializes in Meta Ads for ecommerce brands? Can you look at a competitor's winning ad and immediately understand why it works — the hook, the pacing, the clip choice, the emotional beat — and replicate that thinking, not just the edit?

If you answered an enthusiastic "YES," KEEP READING.

We run an international ecommerce brand selling both physical and digital products (ebooks, video courses) to English-speaking audiences in the US, UK, EU, and Australia. We're looking for a dedicated, full-time Video Editor to join our creative team and eventually grow into Head of Video Editing.

We're not chasing virality. Our goal is one thing: ads that stop the scroll and sell. Every video needs a hook strong enough to interrupt scrolling, and an edit that keeps attention high all the way through.

What you'll own:

Sales-Focused Ad Production: Editing high-conversion Meta ads from scripts we provide — built to sell, not to go viral.

AI Scene Generation & Recreation: Hands-on fluency with AI video tools (Google Flow, Higgsfield, and similar) to generate or recreate scenes and B-roll when what we have isn't enough — you don't wait for footage, you create it.

Clip Curation & Sourcing: We'll provide a folder of selected B-rolls; if additional clips are needed, you source or generate them autonomously. High-quality only — traditional stock footage (Shutterstock, Envato, etc.) is strictly FORBIDDEN.

Script-to-Screen Interpretation: We give you the hook and body copy; you d
 pacing, cuts, and visual rhythm to maximize watch-through and conversion.

Strategic Input, Not Just Execution: We want a creative partner, not a pair of hands. You should actively propose new hooks, new formats, and new angles based on what you're seeing perform — not wait to be told what to test next.

Constant Trend Awareness: You're the kind of editor who's already testing a new AI tool or ad format before we ask about it. Staying ahead of trends in short-form ad creative is part of the job, not an extra.

Subtitle & Detail Precision: Clean, perfectly synced subtitles, no typos, no timing errors — this is an area where we accept zero compromise.

Reliable, On-Time Delivery: Every deadline is a real deadline. Late deliveries disrupt the whole ad pipeline, and consistency here matters as much as editing skill.

Position Requirements:

Full-time availability. This is not a 2-hours-a-day gig. If you're currently juggling 5–6 different clients and can't guarantee us priority and focus, please don't apply.

Immediate or near-immediate start.

2+ years of specific experience editing Meta Ads for ecommerce brands — physical product experience is fine, but experience with digital products (ebooks, courses, info-products) is a strong plus.

Practical experience with AI video generation tools (Google Flow, Higgsfield, or equivalents) — this is not optional, it's core to how we produce content now.

Fluent English — our team and all creative content are in English; you need to understand tone, nuance, and pacing at a native or near-native level.

Strong grasp of hook, retention, and pacing — you should be able to explain why a cut works, not just execute it.

A strategic, growth-minded approach — you think about what's next for the brand's creative, not just what's on today's task list.

Weekend availability when needed, paid accordingly.

Obsessive attention to detail. Subtitles, transitions, and timing must be clean. Mediocrity isn't tolerated on this team.

Genuine passion for the craft of editing, and for staying current with where it's heading.

What We Offer:

Performance bonuses tied to ad results, starting from month one.

Real growth path to Head of Video Editing as the brand scales.

Direct involvement in an international brand's creative strategy — your instincts and proposals shape what we test next.

Approximately 75–80% of the role will support Pauline Interiors. A smaller portion will include executive and personal administrative support for me as the founder.



I am looking for someone who enjoys creating order, figuring things out, following through, and making someone else's life easier.

-Studio Operations & Procurement Support-



Request pricing, availability, lead times, freight information, samples, and product details from vendors

Organize quotes, specifications, tear sheets, and product information

Maintain product, sourcing, procurement, and order-tracking spreadsheets

Follow up with vendors on outstanding questions and orders

This position will eventually involve tracking high-value furnishings and materials, where accuracy in pricing, specifications, quantities, lead times, and order status is extremely important. Please only apply if detailed tracking is one of your strengths.



-Studio Administration-



Organize files, images, contracts, quotes, and project information

Assist with
 organization and draft routine correspondence

Travel and reservation research

Scheduling and calendar coordination

Comparing products, services, vendors, or other options

Property and vacation-rental administration

Tracking refunds, returns, appointments, and deadlines

Miscellaneous personal research and administrative projects



This portion of the role will focus on research, coordination, organization, and logistics rather than household chores.



**You May Be a Great Fit If You Are:



Extremely organized and naturally detail-oriented

An excellent written and spoken English communicator

Comfortable researching something you have never researched before

Resourceful and able to solve problems independently

Someone who notices missing information and asks good questions

Comfortable following systems while also suggesting better ones

Reliable about deadlines and follow-through

Confident working independently without constant supervision

Comfortable using spreadsheets and keeping detailed records

Able to manage several projects and priorities simultaneously

Comfortable handling confidential business and personal information

Interested in a long-term role where responsibility can grow over time



**Experience:



-You should have previous experience in at least one of the following-

Interior design or architecture operations; construction/project coordination; purchasing or procurement; furnishings/FF&E; vendor and supplier coordination; order/inventory management; or another detail-heavy project environment.



-Experience with any of the following is a plus, but you do not need to have all of them-

Interior design, architecture, construction, furnishings, or procurement

Executive assistance or operations

Vendor coordination and order tracking

Google Workspace

Excel or Google Sheets

Canva- presentation design, social media scheduling, or basic visual content creation

Project-management software 

AI tools such as ChatGPT

Research-heavy administrative roles



--Interior design experience is not required. Strong organization, judgment, communication, and ability to learn are more important.

--Please describe your most relevant experience with procurement, purchasing, vendor/supplier coordination, order tracking, construction/design project administration, or inventory management. Be specific about what you personally handled. If you do not have experience in any of these areas, please say so.



**Schedule:



This role will begin at approximately 15 hours per week, with the potential to grow toward 20–25+ hours as the role develops.



Much of the work can be completed asynchronously during normal Philippines working hours. There will occasionally be scheduled meetings or training that require limited overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.



**Compensation:



$6–$7 USD/hour depending on experience and qualifications.



This is intended to be a long-term position. Increased hours, compensation, and responsibility are available for someone who becomes an important part of the studio.

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a brief paid practical exercise before a video interview.



I am looking for someone who wants to grow with a small business over time, take increasing ownership, and become a trusted part of Pauline Interiors.

title: Part-Time UGC and Short-Form Ad Video Editor
description:
Part-Time UGC and Short-Form Ad Video Editor



I’m looking for a skilled short-form video editor who understands UGC-style content and knows how to turn raw footage into fast-paced, engaging ads for Instagram
 and other Meta placements.



I currently create between 100 and 200 videos per month for multiple companies, and I want to increase that output by outsourcing much of the editing. This will begin as a part-time position requiring approximately four hours per day, with the potential to grow into a larger or full-time role.



I work in the Pacific Time zone, so you should be available for some overlap with normal working hours in PT. You do not necessarily need to live in the same time zone, but communication and turnaround times should align with my schedule.



What You’ll Be Doing



Editing short-form UGC and talking-head and b-roll advertisements

Removing pauses, dead space, filler and unnecessary footage

Tightening the pacing so every video feels concise and engaging

Adding clean, accurate and visually appealing captions

Using punch-ins, punch-outs and scale keyframing to create movement

Adding pattern interrupts, B-roll, graphics and sound effects when appropriate

Emphasizing hooks, important statements and calls to action

Creating polished ads that will run through Meta for multiple companies

Following brand-specific examples and maintaining consistent editing styles

Managing revisions through a simple, organized feedback process

Uploading approved videos to my Trybe account

Organizing projects and delivering videos on schedule

Handling a relatively high volume of short-form content

Feedback and Communication



I want the review process to be as simple and efficient as possible. Ideally, you already use a video-review platform such as 
, Dropbox Replay, Vimeo Review or another tool that allows me to leave time-stamped comments directly on each video.



Please mention the review and feedback software you currently use when applying. If you have a better system for managing a high volume of edits and revisions, I’m open to your recommendations.



Our primary day-to-day communication will be through WhatsApp, so you must be comfortable communicating consistently and professionally there.



Once a video has been reviewed and approved, you will be responsible for uploading the finished version to my Trybe account and ensuring the correct file is properly labeled and organized.



Who I’m Looking For



You should:



Have experience editing UGC, TikTok, Instagram Reels or short-form advertisements

Understand direct-response advertising and retention-focused editing

Know how to capture attention within the first few seconds

Have excellent instincts for pacing, timing and removing dead space

Know how to use captions, keyframes and visual changes without making videos feel over-edited

Be comfortable adapting videos for different brands, products and audiences

Be able to follow an established style while contributing creative ideas

Be dependable, organized and comfortable working with a high volume of content

Communicate clearly and respond well to feedback

Be available for approximately four hours per weekday

Have some working-hour overlap with the Pacific Time zone

Be comfortable using WhatsApp as the primary communication channel

Be able to upload and organize approved videos in Trybe

Experience editing direct-response ads or performance-marketing content for Meta is strongly preferred.



Editing Style



I’m looking for clean, modern and engaging editing. I do not want unnecessary effects everywhere. The goal is to make the speaker feel natural while keeping the viewer’s attention through:



Strong opening hooks

Tight cuts

Fast, natural pacing

Strategic punch-ins and punch-outs

Accurate captions

Relevant B-roll and graphics

Subtle sound design

Effective visual pattern interrupts

Clear calls to action

Some green screen effects



Because these videos will be used as paid advertisements, each editing decision should help improve clarity, viewer retention and conversion rather than simply making the video look flashy.



To Apply

Please send:



A brief introduction and your location/time zone

Links to three examples of UGC or short-form ads you edited

Examples of any Meta ads you have edited

The editing software you use

The video-review or feedback platform you use

Your typical turnaround time

Your monthly rate/per video rate

Your approximate daily availability in Pacific Time

A short explanation of how you make a talking-head video more engaging

Confirmation that you are comfortable communicating through WhatsApp and uploading approved videos to Trybe

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a brief paid editing test using the same raw footage. This will help evaluate pacing, captions, creative judgment, communication and overall fit.

title: Virtual Parts & Procurement Coordinator
description:
Virtual Parts & Procurement Coordinator



**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 7:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Eastern Time

**Location:** Remote



About the Role



We are looking for a highly organized, responsive **Virtual Parts & Procurement Coordinator** to support our Parts and Supply Chain operations. This role serves as a key point of contact for parts customers while helping keep estimates, payments, Parts Research requests, purchase orders, and order updates moving forward.



You’ll be responsible for the day-to-day follow-through that creates a great customer experience and gives our internal Supply Chain team more time to focus on purchasing, sourcing, technical research, inventory, and complex procurement needs.



## What You’ll Do



* Answer inbound parts calls, emails, and assigned leads.

* Gather customer and equipment information, including make/model, serial numbers, data tags, photos, quantities, and requested parts.

* Create and maintain accurate customer and lead records.

* Coordinate requests requiring technical identification with our internal Parts Research team.

* Create and send parts estimates using approved information.

* Follow up consistently on open estimates through sale or closure.

* Communicate pricing, availability, and lead times to customers.

* Send payment links or instructions and follow up on routine outstanding payments.

* Create clear handoffs to Supply Chain when parts are ready to be ordered or shipped.

* Follow up on open purchase orders and vendor acknowledgments.

* Maintain accurate expected ship dates, lead times, backorder/delay information, and tracking details.

* Keep customers and internal teams informed throughout the process.

* Proactively flag delays, exceptions, or issues requiring additional support.



## What Success Looks Like



You are responsive, organized, and consistent. Customers receive timely communication, estimates don’t fall through the cracks, open orders have clear status updates, and internal teams can quickly determine where an order stands.



Key performance expectations include:



* **95%+** compliance with inbound customer response standards

* **98%+** compliance with required parts estimate follow-up

* **95%+** compliance with open purchase order visibility requirements



## What This Role Does Not Own

This role supports procurement and order coordination but does **not** independently make purchasing, sourcing, pricing, or technical parts-identification decisions. Complex vendor issues, inventory management, physical receiving/shipping, and other procurement exceptions remain with the internal Supply Chain team.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is:



* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Comfortable communicating with customers by phone and email

* Consistent with follow-up and task management

* Able to manage multiple open requests without losing track of details

* Proactive about communicating delays and next steps

* Comfortable working across multiple systems and maintaining accurate records

* Team-oriented and able to coordinate effectively with Sales, Service, and Supply Chain

* Able to work consistently during **7:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Eastern Time**



This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys customer service, coordination, organization, and keeping processes moving from initial request through completion.

title: HR Recruiter
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced **Senior Recruiter** to lead and execute full-cycle and strategic recruitment initiatives across a variety of roles within the organization. This role demands not only excellent sourcing and assessment skills, but also a deep understanding of strategic talent acquisition practices—from workforce planning to pipeline development.



The Senior Recruiter will partner closely with department heads and senior leadership to build recruitment strategies that align with business goals and support organizational growth.



**Prior recruitment experience within the Property Management or Real Estate industry is strongly required**, particularly in hiring for roles such as Property Managers, HOA/Community Association Managers, Maintenance Coordinators, Leasing professionals, Finance staff, and other property management support positions.



### Key Responsibilities



* Lead and oversee the strategic recruitment process, including proactive talent sourcing, candidate engagement, and workforce planning for both immediate and future hiring needs.

* Manage full-cycle recruitment for **Property Management, HOA/Condominium Association, Maintenance, Leasing, Finance, Operations, and other related positions**.

* Serve as a consultative partner to department heads and executives, offering insights and solutions to hiring challenges and building long-term recruitment plans.

* Conduct job intake meetings with hiring managers to define the ideal candidate profile, assess role criticality, and align on recruitment strategies.

* Design and implement targeted sourcing campaigns on platforms such as LinkedIn, OnlineJobs.ph, Indeed, and other niche job boards.

* Build strong talent pipelines for recurring and hard-to-fill Property Management positions.

* Conduct behavioral and structured interviews and assess candidates for technical skills, experience, communication, and culture fit.

* Evaluate candidates' knowledge of Property Management operations, systems, processes, and industry-specific responsibilities when applicable.

* Review, update, and optimize job descriptions in alignment with market trends, operational needs, and company branding.

* Administer hiring assessments and analyze candidate performance against role requirements.

* Monitor and report recruitment metrics, including time-to-fill, source effectiveness, candidate conversion rates, offer acceptance rates, and hiring quality.

* Mentor and support junior recruiters and recruitment assistants when needed.

* Continuously explore and introduce new tools, sourcing methods, recruitment technologies, and channels to improve recruitment effectiveness and employer branding.



### Qualifications



* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Behavioral Science, Business Administration, or a related field.

* At least **3–5 years of proven experience in strategic and full-cycle recruitment**, preferably within a remote or international work environment.

* **Proven recruitment experience within the Property Management or Real Estate industry is required.**

* Experience recruiting for positions such as **Property Managers, HOA/Community Association Managers, Maintenance Coordinators, Leasing professionals, Property Management Assistants, Operations staff, and related real estate support roles** is highly preferred.

* Strong understanding of Property Management roles, responsibilities, terminology, and candidate profiles.

* Strong background in sourcing executive, specialist, technical, and volume positions across multiple departments.

* Demonstrated expertise in using ATS platforms such as **BambooHR** and sourcing tools such as **LinkedIn Recruiter, OnlineJobs.ph, and Indeed**.

* Proficient in Google Workspace, including Drive, Sheets, and Docs, as well as digital collaboration tools.

* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence and work closely with senior stakeholders and hiring managers.

* High degree of initiative and autonomy, with the ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.

* Analytical mindset with the ability to use recruitment data and metrics to improve hiring decisions and processes.

* Strong sense of discretion and ability to handle sensitive candidate and hiring information with confidentiality.

Your Opportunity:

We are seeking a highly analytical, tech-savvy, and detail-oriented Bookkeeping Virtual Assistant to support our team in maintaining accurate financial records, managing day-to-day bookkeeping functions, and improving the overall efficiency of our internal financial processes. This role also includes optional responsibilities such as assisting with payroll, budgeting, and light administrative support.



You’ll play a key role in maintaining the integrity of our financial data and reporting, supporting leadership with timely insights, and helping streamline routine tasks. The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, and experienced in bookkeeping, with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.





Key Responsibilities:

Record and Categorize Financial Transactions:

Accurately record all financial transactions via Dext-including income, expenses, reimbursements, and adjustments-into the appropriate general ledger accounts. Ensure timely data entry and correct classification in accordance with company policies.



Assist with Payroll Processing:

Collaborate with the Bookkeeper to prepare, review, and process bi-weekly or monthly payroll through Bamboo HR. Ensure accuracy of time entries, tax withholdings, and benefits deductions. Maintain confidentiality and compliance with applicable labor and tax regulations.



Support Licensing and Compliance:

Help manage the renewal and documentation of business licenses through FDACS, permits, and insurance policies. Track expiration dates and assist in filing necessary paperwork to maintain company compliance.



Maintain Financial Spreadsheets and Reports:

Create and update spreadsheets. Ensure accuracy, version control, and clarity in financial documentation shared with leadership.



Provide Administrative Support:

Assist with light administrative duties, including organizing digital records, managing shared folders, and preparing supporting documents for audits or executive review.

Join video calls for onboarding, training, project updates, performance reviews, share progress, and ask clarifying questions.



Perks:

13th month bonus

10 days of paid time off (PTO) during the first year

6 US Holidays (see note below)

Paid Training

Employee Referral Bonus



Specifics:

Full-time role (40 hours per week)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EDT/EST (GMT-5), including a 1-hour unpaid lunch break. This role may require availability for a rotating half-day Saturday shift (8:30 AM–12:30 PM EST), approximately once monthly or more as needed.

Note: While three U.S. holidays are fully observed (Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year's), there may be a need for coverage on other U.S. holidays such as Memorial Day, Independence Day (July 4th), and Labor Day due to high lead volume. This is rotational. 





Must have:

Strong high-speed Wi-Fi

Reliable microphone and camera

Organized and professional home setup



Qualifications:

Experience with bookkeeping platforms (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero, Wave)

Proficiency with Google Sheets or Excel (formulas, pivot tables, etc.)

Strong attention to detail and analytical skills

Excellent written and spoken English communication

Please include the word gold in your introductory message if reading this

Comfortable working independently and in collaboration with leadership





Why Native Pest Management:

At Native Pest Management, we focus on creating long-term careers for our employees with clear paths for growth. Our goal is to become the largest privately held pest control company in Florida, which will continue to open doors for advancement.

With over 10,000 five-star reviews across platforms like Google, Yelp, and Angie’s List, our team takes pride in delivering exceptional service that keeps customers coming back and referring us to others. That reputation is a direct reflection of the hard work and professionalism of our staff.

The pest management industry is rapidly expanding and offers a recession-resistant career path.

We are committed to providing valuable, comprehensive, and affordable benefits to our employees. Each year, we review our programs to ensure they continue to meet these goals and support our team’s evolving needs. We’re committed to your success now and in the future.





This role requires exceptional English language proficiency, with precise pronunciation and highly effective conversational skills, to ensure clear, confident, and professional communication with team members.





What to Expect During the Hiring Process:

Once you submit your application, our HR team may reach out for an initial phone or Zoom interview. Candidates who move forward may then be invited to an additional follow-up interview, via Zoom or GoogleMeet. Applicants must submit a 2–3 minute video recording (or video link) speaking in English. Please introduce yourself and briefly discuss your relevant work experience and skills. We encourage you to speak naturally and conversationally rather than reading from a script, as this helps us better understand your communication style in real-world work situations. Light notes or bullet points are fine, but avoid reading word-for-word. Applications submitted without a video link will not be considered. The application process involves a review, and selected candidates may be invited for a screening or interview which may include a typing test. Applicants unwilling to participate in an interview need not apply. Incomplete applications or those not following instructions will not be considered.



Background Check Statement:

Employment is contingent upon successfully completing a background check, which may include a criminal history verification or equivalent clearance based on the applicant’s country of residence. Please also include the word dollar in the subject line of your application. Any required documentation must be completed within two (2) weeks of the start date.



Native Pest Management is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, or any other status protected by federal or Florida law.

title: Creator Partnerships & Sales Representative
description:
FORM46 is looking for an experienced, confident, and commercially minded Creator Partnerships & Sales Representative to identify creators, build relationships, and manage qualified creators from initial contact through partnership and launch.



This is not simply a lead-generation or appointment-setting role. You will be responsible for developing creator relationships, presenting opportunities, handling questions and objections, and helping turn conversations into successful partnerships.



About FORM46



FORM46 partners with content creators to develop digital products tailored to their audiences.



Our team handles product strategy, development, and backend operations. Your primary responsibility will be the creator-facing side of the business, building and managing relationships with creators from prospecting through launch.



What You’ll Do



* Research and qualify creators based on their content, audience, engagement, and commercial potential.

* Conduct consistent, high-volume personalized outreach across relevant channels.

* Build genuine relationships with creators and manage ongoing conversations.

* Manage replies and follow-ups while keeping opportunities organized.

* Set up and conduct calls with qualified creators.

* Understand creators’ goals, audiences, and current monetization.

* Present relevant partnership and digital-product opportunities clearly and confidently.

* Handle questions, hesitation, and objections professionally.

* Negotiate and help close qualified creator partnerships.

* Coordinate with our internal team as partnerships progress.

* Manage creator relationships through product development, launch, and promotion.

* Maintain accurate records of conversations, follow-ups, and outcomes.



You will not be responsible for creating the digital products.



What We’re Looking For



* Strong experience in sales, business development, partnerships, account management, client acquisition, or similar roles.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

* Proven ability to turn prospects into clients or commercial partnerships.

* Confident conducting calls, presenting opportunities, and asking for commitment.

* Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills.

* Good understanding of social media, creators, audiences, and engagement.

* Strong research, organization, and follow-up skills.

* Comfortable conducting high-volume personalized outreach.

* Able to work independently and take ownership of relationships from initial prospecting through completion.



Experience working directly with creators or influencers is a plus, but strong sales, communication, and relationship-management ability are more important.



We are looking for someone who already knows how to build trust, communicate value, and move a commercial conversation forward. Training will be provided on FORM46’s specific partnership model and processes.



Work Structure



This is a full-time, long-term remote position with flexible working hours.



You should be comfortable managing your own workload, maintaining consistent outreach, scheduling creator calls, managing multiple active relationships, and following partnerships through to completion.



Compensation



$1,200–$1,600 USD per month



Compensation within this range will depend on experience and demonstrated ability.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. A brief introduction and your most relevant professional experience.

2. Your experience in sales, business development, partnerships, client acquisition, or creator/influencer outreach.

3. A specific example where you personally turned a prospect into a client or partnership. Explain your role and how you moved them toward a decision.

4. Describe your experience speaking directly with prospects or clients and handling questions, hesitation, or objections.

5. How would you determine whether a content creator is worth contacting for a potential commercial partnership?

6. How would you approach and build a relationship with a creator who has never heard of you or FORM46?

7. Are you comfortable conducting high-volume personalized outreach while also managing existing creator relationships and follow-ups?

8. What is your expected monthly salary?

9. Include “FORM46” somewhere in your application so we know you read the full posting.

title: CopyWriters
description:
ABOUT THIS ROLE

We are looking for a sharp, instinctive copywriter to handle all written copy for the Success Formula Podcast. For every episode you will deliver title options, thumbnail hook options, a YouTube description, and keyword tags. Your copy needs to stop the scroll, make someone uncomfortable or curious, and make them click before they even know why. This is not a content writing role. We need someone who writes with urgency, thinks in numbers and controversy, and knows how to make a stranger feel something in under five words.



The hook is the most important thing you will write. A weak hook means no one clicks. No clicks means the episode dies. Every hook must make someone either uncomfortable, angry, scared, or so curious they cannot scroll past it.



WHAT YOU WILL DELIVER FOR EVERY EPISODE

✔  4 title options — each one must earn a click on its own

✔  4 thumbnail hook options — short, punchy, all caps, built to shock or provoke

✔  2 YouTube description options — one paragraph that makes someone want to watch right now

✔  15 keyword tags optimized for YouTube and podcast search



THE HOOK — THE GOLDEN RULE

Every hook must do one of three things: hit with a number that hurts, make a controversial statement that makes people argue, or reveal something that sounds like a confession or a mistake. 3 to 6 words max. All caps. No explaining. No motivating. The hook is not a lesson. It is a punch.



NUMBER HOOKS — Lead with a number that stings

52 HOUSES. ZERO PROFIT.

I LOST $2M IN 30 DAYS

140 MILLION AND STILL BROKE

QUIT AFTER 100 DOORS



SHOCK HOOKS — Sound like a confession or a regret

MY WORST INVESTMENT EVER

RENTALS ALMOST RUINED ME

I WISH I NEVER STARTED

CONTRACTORS ROBBED ME BLIND



CONTROVERSY HOOKS — Say the thing nobody wants to admit

RENTALS ARE A SCAM

STOP BUYING HOUSES NOW

YOUR REALTOR IS LYING TO YOU

LANDLORDS LOSE EVERY TIME



The hook must make someone feel something before they understand it. If it explains too much it is already dead. If someone could scroll past it without flinching it is not good enough.



WEAK VS STRONG — KNOW THE DIFFERENCE

If your hook sounds like something you would read in a blog title, throw it out and start over.



❌  WEAK:  How I Made Millions In Real Estate

✅  STRONG:  I LOST $2M IN 30 DAYS

❌  WEAK:  Why Rentals Are Not Always The Best Investment

✅  STRONG:  RENTALS ARE A SCAM

❌  WEAK:  New Construction Can Be Very Profitable

✅  STRONG:  30 PERCENT PROFIT. EVERY BUILD.

❌  WEAK:  Things I Learned From My Real Estate Journey

✅  STRONG:  I WISH I NEVER STARTED



HOW TO WRITE THE TITLE

Titles follow the same energy as hooks but with more context. Use the real numbers from the episode. Use the guest's specific outcome. Make it feel like insider information. Write 4 options per episode from different angles — the loss angle, the win angle, the warning angle, and the blueprint angle.



LOSS ANGLE:  Stop Buying Single Family Rentals Before They Wreck Your Portfolio

WIN ANGLE:  New Construction Blueprint That Turns 150 Dollars Into 140 Million

WARNING ANGLE:  New Construction Warning Never Pay A Contractor Upfront For Labor

BLUEPRINT ANGLE:  Build Your First Spec Home With This Step By Step Developer Plan



HOW TO WRITE THE YOUTUBE DESCRIPTION

Two options per episode. Open with the guest's most painful number or most controversial outcome. Tell the viewer exactly what they will learn. Close with where to find the guest and a reason to subscribe. No generic intros. No motivational fluff. Write it like you are texting someone and you need them to drop what they are doing and watch this right now.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

✔  You write copy that makes people feel something — not copy that sounds professional

✔  You can read a podcast transcript and immediately know the 4 most clickable moments

✔  You think in numbers, controversy, confessions, and outcomes

✔  You know the difference between a hook that punches and a title that explains

✔  Copy is due within 24 hours of receiving the episode brief — no exceptions

✔  Every episode gets the same quality no matter the topic

✔  Strong English writing — clean, direct, zero filler



WHAT WE OFFER

✔  Fully remote — work from anywhere in the world

✔  Flexible schedule — as long as copy is delivered within 24 hours of the episode brief

✔  Weekly pay

✔  Consistent work — new episodes every week

✔  Episode notes and brief provided for every episode

✔  Direct feedback so your copy gets sharper every week



HOW TO APPLY

To apply, complete the writing test below and send it with your application. We will not review any application that skips the test.



WRITING TEST: A guest built a 10 million dollar business after losing everything in a divorce and starting over at 47 with nothing. Write 3 thumbnail hooks and 2 title options for this episode right now. Do not research. Do not overthink. Just write.



•  Your name and country

•  Your 3 hooks and 2 titles from the writing test above

•  Links to any copy you have written for YouTube, podcasts, or social media if you have them

•  Your rate per episode in USD

•  Your available hours per day and timezone

  * Title tags and meta descriptions

  * Image alt text

  * Internal linking

  * Sitemap and indexing checks

  * Basic technical SEO cleanup

  * Structured, search-friendly content improvements where appropriate

* Research, write, upload, format, and optimize **one SEO-focused blog post per month** for three months. Topics will focus on high-intent searches related to:



  * Saffron skincare benefits

  * Clean beauty formulations

  * Multi-use facial, body, and hair oil routines



### Phase 2: Launch, monitor, and optimize



Beginning after the website and tracking foundation are



* Set up approved Meta paid-ad campaigns

* Monitor campaign performance and make recommendations based on data

* Do not change ad spend, targeting, creative, or campaign structure without the founder’s written approval

* Monitor website traffic, conversions,
 signups, abandoned-cart recovery, and SEO progress

* Troubleshoot issues and make approved adjustments based on real user and campaign data

* Provide a simple monthly report with traffic, leads,
 results, cart recovery, sales/conversions, paid-ad performance, insights, and prioritized next steps



This is a 90-day engagement because the systems need to be monitored after launch. The goal is not merely to build them—it is to see what is working and make thoughtful, documented improvements based on real performance.



## Documentation, training, and handoff are mandatory



The founder must not become dependent on one person. Every completed deliverable must include:



* Proof that it is live, tested, and working correctly

* A short Loom video showing what was completed, how it works, and how to maintain or update it

* A simple written SOP/checklist saved in a shared Google Drive folder

* An updated access/tool inventory showing every platform, login location, integration, and recurring task

* Notes on outstanding issues and recommended next steps



At the end of the engagement, you must provide:



* A complete, organized Google Drive handoff folder

* All Loom recordings and written SOPs

* A current access/tool inventory

* A final performance report

* A recorded or live walkthrough teaching the founder how to manage the systems or hand them to the next person



## Payment



Payment is milestone-based. Each milestone is paid only after the work is live, tested, documented with Loom videos and SOPs, and approved.



* **10%:** Website/marketing audit, access inventory, and prioritized 90-day work plan

* **25%:** Website conversion improvements plus GA4, Search Console, Meta Pixel, and conversion tracking live and verified

* **20%:**
 capture, abandoned-cart automation, and SEO/AEO foundation live and documented

* **25%:** Three SEO blog posts completed and approved paid-media campaigns launched, monitored, and reported

* **20%:** Final handoff package and founder walkthrough



**The final 20% is contingent on receipt and approval of the complete handoff package:** all Loom recordings, written SOPs, live/working links, updated access inventory, final report, and founder walkthrough. Incomplete documentation means the final milestone is not complete.



## Required experience



You must have hands-on, proven experience with:



* WordPress and WooCommerce

* GA4, Google Search Console, Meta Pixel, and ecommerce conversion tracking

*
 capture and abandoned-cart automations

* Ecommerce SEO and SEO content writing

* Meta Ads Manager

* Creating simple, clear SOPs and Loom-based handoffs for clients

* Professional written and spoken English



## Application instructions — read carefully



Start your application with the exact words: **“Saffron Systems First.”**



Then include:



1. Two relevant WordPress/WooCommerce ecommerce examples and exactly what you personally completed

2. A 2–3 minute Loom explaining how you verify:



   * Meta Pixel is firing correctly

   * A WooCommerce purchase conversion is being tracked

3. One example of SEO content you wrote for an ecommerce brand

4. A sample SOP, checklist, or Loom handoff you have created before; please remove confidential information

Applications that do not begin with **“Saffron Systems First”** or do not include the requested examples and Loom will not be considered.
