title: Canadian Personal Tax Preparer
description:
Remote · Full-Time January to June · Midnight to 8 AM Philippine Time



ABOUT US



We're a small Canadian bookkeeping and tax firm with a remote team. We're hiring a tax preparer for Canadian personal returns.



ABOUT THE ROLE



You'll prepare Canadian personal income tax returns (T1) from start to ready-to-file: gather the slips, work through the client's documents, flag what's missing, and hand over a clean return for review.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Prepare T1 returns, including self-employment (T2125), rental (T776) and investment income

- Pull slips and prior-year information through CRA Auto-fill my return

- Review client documents, request what's missing, and track open items

- Prepare returns for review and e-filing in Canadian tax software

- Handle CRA notices, reassessments and adjustment requests

- Track filing and payment deadlines for every client



WHO YOU ARE



- Fluent in Canadian tax. You know the T1 and its schedules without looking them up.

- Careful. You tie every slip and every number before a return goes to review.

- Organized. You keep dozens of returns moving at once in tax season.

- Clear. Your document requests and notes are short and specific.



MUST-HAVES



- 2+ Canadian tax seasons preparing T1 returns

- T2125 and T776 experience

- Experience with Canadian tax software

- Excellent written English

- Available full-time from January to June, Monday to Friday, midnight to 8 AM Philippine time (night shift)

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and backup power/internet

- References we can speak with



NICE-TO-HAVES



- Year-round availability for adjustments and bookkeeping support

- Family and couple returns (spousal and dependant credits, pension splitting)

- Corporate (T2) or trust (T3) exposure

- Canadian accounting or tax coursework or designation



SOFTWARE



If you have experience with any of the following, note it in your application and tell us which one you prefer:



- QuickBooks Online Accountant (Pro Tax)

- TaxCycle

- ProFile

- Taxprep (CCH iFirm)

- UFile

- DT Max

- CRA Represent a Client



LOGISTICS



- Schedule: Full-time January to June, Monday to Friday, midnight to 8 AM Philippine time (9 AM to 5 PM Vancouver time). Year-round hours are available for the right person.

- Setup: 100% remote

- Compensation: Based on experience. Share your expectations in your application.

- Term: Every tax season, with year-round work possible



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Generic applications will be ignored.



Follow these instructions exactly:



1. Start the first line of your application with the word SLIPS in capital letters.

2. Answer the four questions below in order, numbered 1, 2, 3, and 4.

3. After your answers, list the software from the list above that you have used, one per line, with the number of tax seasons beside each. If you have used none of them, write "None."

4. On the next line, write PREFERRED: followed by the tax software you prefer to work in and one sentence on why. It can be software that isn't on our list.

5. End your application with your salary expectation for full-time work on these hours from January to June, written as a monthly amount in USD.



The four questions:



1. How many Canadian T1 returns did you prepare last tax season, and roughly how many included self-employment (T2125) or rental (T776) income?

2. A self-employed client sends a year of bank statements and says everything in the account is business. What do you check before you prepare the T2125?

3. A client's Notice of Assessment shows a balance owing because a T4A slip was left off the return. What do you do?

4. What industries have you worked with the most?



Applications that skip any of these steps will not be reviewed.

title: Coverage Virtual Assistant – Canva / AI / GoHighLevel
description:

Type: Remote, Non-Exclusive Contractor

Location: Remote



About the Role



We are looking for a reliable and responsive Coverage Virtual Assistant to support our team during assigned coverage hours.



This is a request-based role. You do not need to stay continuously busy or constantly monitor systems when there are no requests.



You simply need to be reachable, responsive, and ready to help when a request comes in.



During quiet periods, you are free to work on other clients, jobs, or projects, as long as they do not interfere with your ability to respond promptly during your assigned shift.



What You'll Do



You may be asked to:



Make simple Canva edits for graphics, presentations, social posts, PDFs, and other assets

Create or edit images using AI tools

Make basic updates in GoHighLevel (GHL)

Update text, images, buttons, links, forms, pages, funnels, or landing pages

Make simple website or digital asset updates

Handle basic administrative and operational requests

Locate files, information, images, or other digital assets

Respond to team requests during your shift

Complete straightforward tasks or route more complex requests to the right person

Escalate urgent issues when necessary

Follow up on open requests when asked

Provide a brief handoff at the end of your shift if something remains open

Important: Responsiveness



Responsiveness is the most important requirement.



You do not need to constantly watch communication channels. However, when a request comes in during your assigned hours, you must be reachable, acknowledge it promptly, and either handle it or route it to the appropriate person.



If you are unsure how to complete something, escalate rather than guess.



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is:



Reliable and highly responsive

Organized and able to work independently

Comfortable with Canva

Comfortable using AI image generation/editing tools

Familiar with GoHighLevel or able to learn basic GHL tasks quickly

Comfortable with simple website, page, funnel, and digital asset updates

A strong written communicator

Able to follow instructions carefully

Comfortable learning new tools and software

Able to recognize urgent requests and escalate appropriately



You do not need to be an expert in every platform. We care more about your reliability, ability to learn, responsiveness, and judgment.



Short-Form Video & Webinar Requirements



As part of this role, you may also have opportunities to take on additional responsibilities after demonstrating that you can perform well.



Please answer these questions in your application:



1. Are you willing to record short-form videos about various topics, products, and services?



2. Once you've proven good at short-form videos, are you willing to run approximately 45-minute webinars that we have prepared and trained you for?



3. Are you flexible with your schedule and available for a 5-day coverage shift, including weekends?



4. How soon can you start, given that this shift is scheduled to begin soon?



Please answer all four questions clearly in your application.



7-Day Trial Policy



All candidates will complete a full 7-day evaluation period. Work quality, reliability, responsiveness, and communication will be reviewed throughout the trial.



Passed Trial: Candidates who meet our performance standards will receive full pay for the 7-day trial and may be offered the opportunity to join the team long-term.



Unpassed Trial: Candidates who do not meet the required performance standards may have their trial terminated without payment for the trial period.



Participation in the trial is strictly provisional and does not constitute an employment contract.



Please only apply if you are comfortable with and agree to this trial policy.



How Requests Are Handled



The normal process is:



Request Received → Acknowledge → Handle if Appropriate → Escalate/Assign if Needed → Confirm Status → Handoff if Still Open



Simple requests should be completed whenever possible.



More complex requests should be escalated to the appropriate team member or specialist.



Shift Handoff



If something is still open when your shift ends, provide a short handoff including:



What was requested

What has been completed

What is still pending

Whether anything is urgent

Who should handle the next step



The goal is to make sure the next person can continue without starting over.



Why This Role May Be a Good Fit



This role is intentionally flexible.



When there are no active requests, you can work on other clients or projects. We are not looking for someone to create unnecessary work just to stay busy.



We are looking for someone we can trust to be available and responsive when the team actually needs help.



If you are reliable, responsive, comfortable with Canva/AI/GHL, and can work independently, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Part-Time Video Editor & After Effects Specialist
description:
We are a social media agency focused on creating viral short-form content, reels, and marketing content for businesses and brands.



We are looking for a talented part-time Video Editor & After Effects Specialist who can help us turn the footage and content we provide into high-quality, engaging social media videos.



A big part of our workflow will also involve AI video editing and AI-generated content. We will provide the footage, images, concepts, and/or AI-generated material, and your job will be to put everything together into a polished final video.



Your responsibilities



* Edit short-form videos and viral reels

* Work with footage and content that we provide

* Use AI tools and AI-generated video content as part of the editing process

* Combine different clips, images, animations, and AI-generated elements into one engaging video

* Fine-tune and improve videos using Adobe After Effects

* Create motion graphics, animations, visual effects, transitions, and other enhancements

* Add subtitles, sound effects, music, and other elements where needed

* Make sure the final videos look professional, engaging, and suitable for social media

* Take our raw materials and creative direction and turn them into finished content

* Make adjustments and improvements based on our feedback



What we’re looking for



You should be a very good video editor with strong Adobe After Effects skills.



Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:



* Adobe After Effects

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* CapCut

* AI video editing / AI video generation tools



Strong After Effects skills are especially important. You should be comfortable taking an existing video and fine-tuning it with effects, animations, motion graphics, transitions, and other visual improvements.



We are not looking for someone who simply cuts clips together. We want someone who can take the material we provide and turn it into high-quality, engaging, viral-style social media content.



You should:



* Have a strong eye for detail

* Understand short-form social media content

* Be creative and have a good sense of pacing

* Be comfortable working with AI-generated video/content

* Be able to work independently

* Be able to follow instructions and creative direction

* Be open to feedback and revisions

* Have previous video editing experience

* Have a portfolio or examples of your previous work



About the position



This is a part-time position of approximately 10 hours per week.



We will provide you with the footage, images, concepts, and other materials. You will be responsible for editing everything together, adding the necessary creative elements, using AI where appropriate, and fine-tuning the final result in After Effects.



We are a growing social media agency and are looking for someone who can become a reliable, long-term member of our team. If the collaboration works well, there may be opportunities for more hours and more work in the future.



Please include your portfolio and examples of your best video editing work when applying. If you have examples of After Effects, motion graphics, or AI video editing work, please include those as well.

title: Phone Support Representative — Subscription Retention
description:
📞 PHONE SUPPORT & RETENTION REPRESENTATIVE



Location: Remote — Philippines



Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST



Philippine Time: Approximately 9:00 PM–5:00 AM PHT during US daylight saving time, shifting to 10:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT during US winter



Start Date: Immediately



Employment: Full-Time | Long-Term Remote



> ⚠️ Please apply only if you can commit to the US EST night-shift schedule long term.



---



📌 IMPORTANT — HOW TO APPLY



Please read the complete job description before applying.



After reviewing and understanding the role, ALL applications must be completed through our official application form:



👉 APPLY HERE:







Incomplete applications will NOT be reviewed.



Please make sure you follow all instructions and complete every required section of the application.



---



About the Role



We are a growing US subscription brand building our Phone Support & Retention Team from the ground up.



You'll spend your day speaking directly with American customers — many of whom are calling because they want to cancel their subscription, pause their account, or request a refund.



Your job isn't simply to read a script and process a ticket.



You'll need to have genuine conversations, understand why the customer wants to leave, and use approved retention offers to give them a reason to stay.



When you save a customer, that's a win.



When you can't, you'll professionally process their cancellation or refund while they're still on the phone — accurately, efficiently, and without letting a difficult interaction affect the way you treat the customer.



This role is ideal for someone who is:



* Confident on the phone

* Comfortable handling objections

* Skilled at customer retention

* Calm under pressure

* Comfortable dealing with frustrated customers

* Able to balance customer experience with company policies



---



🚀 Growth Opportunity



This is a brand-new team, and we intend to promote our first Customer Service Manager from the people hired in this round.



If you're interested in growing into a leadership role, tell us in your application.



---



What You'll Do



As a Phone Support & Retention Representative, you will:



* Take inbound calls from US customers requesting cancellations, pauses, or refunds

* Ask the right questions to understand the customer's actual reason for leaving

* Handle objections and negotiate using approved retention offers

* Recommend appropriate solutions, such as:

  * Skipping a shipment

  * Changing subscription frequency

  * Applying an approved discount

  * Downgrading the subscription

  * Offering an approved free product

* Process cancellations and refunds directly in Shopify during the live call

* Accurately document every interaction in Zendesk

* Select the correct call outcome and reason codes

* Escalate issues quickly when they fall outside your authority

* Meet retention, refund accuracy, productivity, and call quality targets



---



Requirements



Must-Have



📞 Phone & Customer Support Experience



* Fluent spoken English with clear, natural communication that American customers can easily understand

* Proven phone support experience with US customers

* Experience handling live voice calls

* Previous experience in customer retention, saves, objection handling, or sales

* Experience handling angry, frustrated, or demanding customers



> Chat/email-only experience does not qualify.



🛒 Shopify Experience



Hands-on Shopify experience is required, including:



* Finding customer orders

* Processing refunds

* Managing cancellations

* Managing subscriptions



💻 CRM / Helpdesk Experience



Experience using a CRM or helpdesk platform.



Zendesk is preferred, but experience with platforms such as:



* Richpanel

* Gorgias

* Similar CRM/helpdesk platforms



is also acceptable.



🎧 Work Setup



You must have:



* Reliable wired internet connection

* Backup internet and/or power solution

* Quiet, professional workspace

* Good-quality noise-cancelling headset

* Ability to navigate systems while speaking with customers and documenting information accurately

* Strong attention to detail when processing refunds and cancellations

* Willingness to work the required US EST night shift long term



---



⭐ Bonus Points



You'll stand out if you have:



* Experience with Checkout Champ

* Experience with 
, Konnektive, ReCharge, or LimeLight

* Experience working for a DTC or subscription-based brand

* Chargeback prevention or dispute handling experience

* Previous experience specifically in subscription retention



---



Who Will Do Well in This Role?



You don't get rattled when a customer says "No."



You know how to ask one more question without being pushy.



You don't take cancellations personally, and you don't become defensive when someone is rude.



You're able to protect company policies while still sounding like a real person — not a robot reading a script.



You know how to:



* Listen

* Ask the right questions

* Negotiate

* Handle objections

* Identify what the customer actually needs

* Find opportunities to retain customers



And when a customer ultimately d
 to cancel, you can process the refund professionally and move on.



A well-handled cancellation still protects the brand.



---



❌ This Role Is NOT for You If:



* You need a script for every customer interaction

* You become defensive when customers push back

* Angry customers easily overwhelm you

* You have little or no live phone support experience

* You are uncomfortable discussing cancellations, refunds, and retention

* You cannot consistently work the required US EST schedule



---



💼 Why Join Us?



* Full-time, long-term remote opportunity

* Join a new team and help build it from the ground up

* Opportunity for career growth into Customer Service Management

* Direct exposure to US customers and subscription operations

* Build expertise in customer retention, Shopify, Zendesk, and DTC customer experience

* Potential to grow into a leadership position as the team expands



---



📝 HOW TO APPLY



Incomplete applications will NOT be reviewed.



After reading and understanding the job description, all applications must be completed through the application form below:



👉 APPLY HERE:







Your application must include the following:



1. Previous Experience



List the brands/companies you've worked for, including:



* Company name

* What the company sold/provided

* Your position

* How long you worked there



2. Refund & Cancellation Experience



Tell us:



* Have you personally processed refunds and cancellations?

* Have you used Shopify, Checkout Champ, or both?

* What were you authorized to do independently?

* What required supervisor approval?



3. 🎙️ 60-Second Voice Recording



Submit a 60-second voice recording speaking naturally.



Tell us about a real customer call where the customer wanted to cancel but you successfully retained them.



Please explain:



* What the customer wanted

* Why they wanted to cancel

* How you handled the conversation

* What you said or offered

* How the call ended



> Please do not read a prepared script. We want to hear how you naturally communicate.



4. Previous Call Recordings



If you have recordings of real customer calls you've handled and are legally/permissibly allowed to share, please include them.



5. Availability



Clearly confirm:



"I am available Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST."



6. Start Date



Tell us how soon you can start.



We are looking for candidates who can begin immediately.



---



📌 FINAL NOTE



If you're confident on the phone, know how to handle objections, and can turn a difficult cancellation call into a positive customer experience, we want to hear from you.



We're looking for people who can do more than follow a script — we're looking for people who can listen, think, negotiate, and genuinely help customers.

description:
Senior Helpdesk Technician | EST/EDT Time Zone

Working Days: Monday - Friday

Type: Full-Time

Rate: $5.00 – $9.00 USD per hour (Depending on Experience)





ONLY APPLICANTS WHO COMPLETE THE

FULL INSTRUCTIONS WILL BE CONSIDERED







COMPANY SUMMARY

- - - - - - - -



We are a US-based Managed IT Service Provider (MSP) specializing in IT Support, Cybersecurity, Cloud Solutions, and Compliance for businesses nationwide. We are headquartered in New Jersey and serve SMBs and regulated industries that demand high security, reliability, and exceptional support.



We value:

> Integrity and honesty (dishonesty of any form is not tolerated)

> Accountability

> Professionalism

> A team culture built on trust, communication, and continuous improvement



We operate in a fast-paced, collaborative environment supporting mission-critical technology for our clients. We value proactive, detail-oriented, and dependable individuals who take pride in delivering high-quality work.





POSITION SUMMARY

- - - - - - - -



We are seeking Level 2/3 Helpdesk Technicians to deliver high-quality remote IT support to our business clients. This is a fast-paced, client-facing role requiring strong troubleshooting skills, exceptional communication, and deep familiarity with MSP tools and workflows.



You will resolve Level 1 and Level 2 issues, assist with projects, collaborate with our ConnectWise NOC, and interact with SaaS vendors and software support teams. Technicians must maintain a security-first mindset in all work.



You will respond to and resolve issues such as:

• Business application support (M365, SaaS apps, Azure AD)

• Microsoft Admin Portal / Entra / Azure issues

• Google Workspace support

•
 delivery issues (client + server side)

• Firewall/UTM configuration changes

• Credential issues, password resets, MFA configuration

• PC performance and system troubleshooting

• Printer/scanner issues

• VPN and remote access problems



This is an after-hours role designed to support clients during evening operations and maintenance windows.



** Must have excellent English writing and speaking skills and be comfortable supporting clients on the phone all day. **







KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- - - - - - - -



• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 technical support to business clients.

• Diagnose and resolve issues related to servers, workstations, M365, Azure, networking, and cloud apps.

• Triage, update, and close tickets using ConnectWise Manage.

• Work closely with our ConnectWise NOC/helpdesk and internal team.

• Communicate clearly with clients in a professional, friendly manner.

• Assist with projects, migrations, and automation as needed.

• Work with software and SaaS vendors to resolve client issues.

• Maintain accurate documentation in IT Glue.

• Follow all security-first best practices.

• Ensure ticket notes are detailed, client-ready, and updated in real time.

• Maintain daily workflow discipline (board cleanup, ticket follow-up, mailbox cleanup, etc.).





REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

- - - - - - - -



• Proven MSP experience (Level 2 required)

• Strong English communication (written + verbal)

• Deep understanding of troubleshooting Windows, networks, and cloud environments

• Ability to diagnose and resolve issues independently and efficiently

• Proficiency with:

-- ConnectWise Manage (PSA)

-- ConnectWise Asio / Automate (RMM)

-- IT Glue Documentation

-- Microsoft 365 Admin Centers (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams)

-- Entra ID / Azure AD (Identity, groups, MFA, SSO, access policies)

-- Azure (VMs, networking, storage – preferred)

-- Google Workspace

-- Firewall portals: Sophos, SonicWall, Todyl (preferred)



• Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, routing, VLANs, VPN)

• Ability to follow SOPs and update documentation clearly & accurately

• Must demonstrate STRONG INTEGRITY, HONESTY, and ACCOUNTABILITY in all work





PREFERRED SKILLS (Bonus but not required)

- - - - - - - -



• 2+ years technical support experience

• Experience with Intune, Endpoint Manager, M365 Compliance

• Experience with Ubiquiti hardware and cloud controllers

• Familiarity with IT Glue, Confluence, or ITBoost

• PowerShell scripting and command-line experience

• API/Webhook configuration experience

• Prior ConnectWise helpdesk experience (major plus)

• Vendor certifications (Microsoft, Cisco, SonicWall, Sophos, CompTIA)





CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

- - - - - - - -



• CompTIA A+ required within 1 year of hire

• Any 2 Microsoft certifications required within 1 year of hire





HOME OFFICE REQUIREMENTS

- - - - - - - -



> Dedicated work area (quiet, distraction-free & video appropriate)

> Backup power (UPS or similar)

> Stable internet: 10 Mbps minimum

> Modern PC (currently 12GB+ RAM, Intel i5+ CPU and SSD)

title: Direct Response Video Creative – Editor, Scriptwriter & Designer (Lead Generation)
description:
ABOUT US



We're a UK-based performance marketing agency running paid social campaigns that generate leads for different types of industries. Every ad we make has one job: to drive qualified leads.



We're looking for one creative person to own our video and ad creative. This isn't a "make it look pretty" role. We need someone who understands why an ad converts, can write the script that makes it work, and can edit it into something that stops the scroll.



---



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



- Writing direct response video scripts, hooks and ad copy built to generate leads

- Editing short-form video ads for
, Instagram and TikTok (UGC style, b-roll, talking head, motion graphics)

- Producing AI-generated video and imagery and making it look real, polished and on-brand

- Designing static ad creatives and graphics

- Testing new angles, hooks and formats, and using performance results to d
 what to make next

- Working with our internal tools and systems for generating graphics and video, and improving them so the output is better and faster than what we produce today



---



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Proven experience creating direct response ads for lead generation (not just brand content or social media posting)

- Strong copywriting and scriptwriting skills: you know what makes a hook work, how to structure an ad, and how to write to a specific customer's pain points

- Advanced video editing: pacing, captions, b-roll, motion graphics, sound design

- Hands-on experience with AI video and image generation tools

- Confidence using AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude in your daily workflow

- Graphic design skills for static ads

- The ability to follow proven systems and processes, and the initiative to improve them

- Fast, efficient turnaround without sacrificing quality

- Strong written and spoken English



---



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with Meta or TikTok advertising (launching, testing or reading ad performance)

- Experience with UK or US audiences

- Experience in AI tools



---



WHAT WE OFFER



- Long-term, full-time remote position

- Work on real campaigns with real budgets and see the results of your creative directly

- Access to our internal creative systems, frameworks and AI tools

- Room to grow as we scale



---



HOW TO APPLY



1. Record a 30-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself and telling us about one ad you made that generated leads, and why you think it worked.

2. Send links to your portfolio, including video ads you've scripted and/or edited. Direct response work is what we want to see.

3. List the editing, design and AI tools you use most.

4. Start your application with the words "LEADS FIRST" so we know you read this post in full.



Applications without a video or portfolio will not be considered.

description:
We're Hiring: Account Manager (Remote | Full-Time | Philippines-Based)



Applications that do not directly answer the questions below will not be considered.



Marketing Done Right (MDR) is growing — and we're looking for a people-first, organized, and marketing-savvy Account Manager to join our team.



This isn't a "pass the message along" kind of role. We need someone who genuinely cares about client success, can confidently navigate conversations about SEO and Google Ads strategy, and knows how to keep multiple accounts running smoothly without anything slipping through the cracks. If clients consistently feel like they're in great hands with you — this role was built for you.

- Serving as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts via email and video calls

- Leading monthly or bi-monthly client update calls with clear, transparent performance insights

- Guiding new clients through a smooth onboarding experience during their first 30–60 days

- Translating client goals, emails, and meeting notes into clear internal tasks and briefs in Asana

- Coordinating between clients and internal SEO, PPC, content, design, and development teams

- Creating content plans for each client based on their specific needs and campaign direction

- Explaining SEO and Google Ads strategies to clients in plain, meaningful terms that connect to their business goals

- Proactively managing expectations, addressing concerns early, and keeping client confidence high

- Tracking communication, approvals, and project statuses across multiple active accounts

- Working knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, content strategy, website updates, and reporting tools

- Excellent written and verbal English communication — clear, professional, and client-friendly

- Strong relationship-building instincts — warm, credible, and trustworthy from day one

- Organized and detail-oriented — nothing falls through the cracks on your watch

- Proactive mindset — you follow up without being asked and take real ownership

- Genuine care for client outcomes — you treat clients' investments seriously

- Experience in a client-facing or account management role is a plus, especially in a marketing agency

Why Join MDR?

- Paid Leaves & PH Holidays – We value your time off

title: Leasing Sales Agent
description:
LEASING SALES SPECIALIST

AppFolio Experience Required



Remote • Philippines-based • Full-time

Tuesday–Saturday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m. U.S. Eastern, with a one-hour break

Negotiable base pay + performance bonuses



Community Room Rental provides private rooms in shared homes in Charlotte and Durham, North Carolina. We’re looking for a motivated salesperson to own incoming leads—from their first inquiry through move-in.



You should naturally ask: What is holding this person back, and what can I do today to move this opportunity forward? Success means helping qualified prospects become residents while protecting our standards and setting clear expectations.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



* The leasing process: Contact leads, understand their needs, recommend suitable rooms, coordinate tours, process applications, and follow through on leases, deposits, and move-ins.

* Sales follow-up: Make purposeful calls, send personalized texts, address objections, and establish clear next steps. Prioritize promising prospects and bring recommendations when opportunities stall.

* Our standards: Follow established screening, credit, pricing, documentation, and approval procedures. Explain costs and shared-living expectations honestly.

* Your daily workflow: Use time blocks to organize guest cards, applications, calls, texts,
s, Craigslist ads, and receptionist reports while responding promptly to live sales opportunities.

* AppFolio records: Keep statuses, notes, follow-up dates, and handoffs accurate and current.

* Operations backup: When our Operations Manager is away, including Saturdays, triage resident calls, coordinate urgent needs within your authority, and document routine matters for follow-up.



WHAT YOU BRING



Hands-on AppFolio experience is required. Clear, confident spoken and written English is essential—our sales conversations happen through phone calls and texts. Previous sales results and experience with a real estate, leasing, or property management company are strongly preferred.



We value integrity, commitment, and a desire to learn. Be honest about mistakes, take ownership of your goals, welcome coaching, and follow through without constant reminders. Co-living experience is a plus; we’re happy to teach our business to someone who learns quickly and takes initiative.



COMPENSATION



Base pay is negotiable according to experience. Performance bonuses are tied to occupancy, revenue per available room, and conversion through the leasing funnel. Results must be achieved within our established standards.



If this sounds like you, please apply. I will personally read your application and work samples and answer any questions you may have—seriously, the more questions, the better! Be sure to answer our questions AND please start the first line of your application with “AppFolio Leasing Agent” so I know you read the complete job description.



TO APPLY



Submit directly through OnlineJobs.ph and include:



1. Your résumé.

2. A link to a 30–60-second video pitch explaining why you would succeed in this role.

3. Your Myers-Briggs/personality-test results from the platform.

4. Answers to these questions:



   * Do you have experience with AppFolio? If so, how long have you used it?

   * Which modules have you worked in, and what tasks did you handle?

   * Have you taken AppFolio’s online courses? If so, which ones?



Selected applicants will receive written questions, followed by a live video interview, a practical leasing exercise, and reference checks. Personality results provide supplementary background; demonstrated skills and judgment drive our evaluation.



We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us and takes pride in turning opportunities into successful move-ins.



Jason

Community Room Rental

title: Business Development and Appointment Setting Executive
description:
Summary

We are looking for a confident and motivated Business Development and Appointment Setting Executive to generate new sales opportunities within the UK market.



The successful candidate will research suitable businesses, identify the correct decision makers, make outbound calls, qualify potential clients and book appointments or online demonstrations for our sales team.



This is a performance focused role. The successful candidate will receive a basic salary or hourly rate together with commission or bonuses based on qualified appointments, attended demonstrations and successful sales.



## Main Responsibilities



• Research UK businesses that match our target customer profile.



• Build accurate prospect lists containing the company name, website, location, industry, decision maker’s name, job title, telephone number and
 address.



• Verify contact information before adding it to our database or CRM.



• Make outbound calls to business owners and decision makers.



• Introduce our services clearly, confidently and professionally.



• Ask appropriate questions to understand the prospect’s current situation, requirements and challenges.



• Qualify prospects according to the criteria provided by the company.



• Book qualified appointments and online demonstrations for the sales team.



• Send appointment confirmations and reminders to help reduce missed appointments.



• Follow up with prospects who have shown an interest but are not yet ready to book.



• Maintain complete and accurate records of calls, conversations, follow ups and appointments in the CRM.



• Provide daily and weekly performance reports.



• Work towards agreed targets for calls, conversations, qualified opportunities, attended appointments and completed sales.



## Performance Based Pay



The compensation package will include:



• A basic salary or hourly rate.



• A bonus for each qualified appointment that attends the scheduled meeting.



• Additional commission for appointments that result in a completed sale.



• Higher commission or performance bonuses for consistently exceeding monthly targets.



Commission will normally be based on attended and properly qualified appointments rather than appointments that are cancelled, missed or incorrectly qualified.



The exact salary, commission structure and targets will be agreed before employment begins.



## What Counts as a Qualified Appointment



A qualified appointment must meet the following conditions:



• The prospect is a genuine business owner or relevant decision maker.



• The business matches our agreed target customer profile.



• The prospect has been informed about the purpose of the appointment.



• The prospect has expressed a genuine interest in discussing our services.



• The prospect has agreed to a specific date and time.



• The correct telephone number and
 address have been confirmed.



Appointments booked with individuals who are not interested, do not have decision making authority or do not understand the purpose of the meeting will not be considered qualified.



## Required Experience and Skills



• Previous experience in business to business cold calling, telesales, lead generation, appointment setting or business development.



• Excellent spoken and written English.



• A clear, confident and professional telephone manner suitable for speaking with UK businesses.



• Strong listening, questioning and objection handling skills.



• Experience finding reliable business and decision maker contact information.



• Familiarity with Google Maps, LinkedIn, company websites and reputable business directories.



• Experience using prospecting platforms such as Apollo, Lusha, Hunter or similar services is desirable.



• Experience using Zoho CRM, HubSpot, GoHighLevel or another customer relationship management system is desirable.



• Strong organisation and attention to detail.



• Ability to work independently and achieve agreed performance targets.



• A reliable internet connection, computer and professional quality headset.



## Performance Measures



Performance will be reviewed based on:



• Accurate and verified business records added.



• Outbound calls completed.



• Meaningful conversations with decision makers.



• Qualified sales opportunities generated.



• Qualified appointments booked.



• Appointments attended by prospects.



• Sales generated from booked appointments.



• Accuracy of CRM records and follow up activities.



## UK Data and Calling Compliance



The successful candidate must follow the company’s data protection and marketing procedures, including applicable UK GDPR, Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations, Telephone Preference Service and Corporate Telephone Preference Service requirements.



Business information must be collected and used responsibly. Misleading introductions, aggressive calling practices and unauthorised bulk contact methods will not be accepted.



## Working Arrangements



• Remote position.



• Working hours must cover normal UK business hours.



• Initial training, service information, qualification criteria and approved calling scripts will be provided.



• Performance will be reviewed during an initial probationary period.



• Continued employment will depend on call quality, appointment quality, attendance rates and overall results.



## How to Apply



Please provide:



1. A summary of your cold calling and appointment setting experience.



2. Details of your experience calling businesses in the UK.



3. The prospecting and CRM systems you have used.



4. Your average number of calls and qualified appointments per month.



5. A short voice recording introducing yourself and demonstrating how you would open a business call.



6. Your expected basic salary or hourly rate.



7. Your availability during UK working hours.

title: DROPSHIPPING CREATIVE EDITOR — JOB OPPORTUNITY
description:
WE’RE HIRING: CREATIVE EDITOR FOR DROPSHIPPING



We are looking for an experienced Creative Editor specialized in Dropshipping, Performance Marketing and AI Creative Production.



The niche does NOT matter.



You may have worked with fashion, jewelry, beauty, home products, accessories, gadgets, wellness or any other dropshipping niche.



What matters is that you understand how to create high-converting creatives that sell.



This is NOT a traditional video editing position.



We need someone who understands the entire creative process:



RESEARCH → ANGLES → HOOKS → CONCEPTS → AI GENERATION → EDITING → VARIATIONS → TESTING



You should:



• Have proven experience creating and editing creatives specifically for dropshipping / e-commerce stores



• Be extremely good at finding new marketing angles for products



• Have the creative vision to constantly come up with new concepts, new formats and new ways of presenting the same product



• Be able to look at one product and develop multiple completely different advertising angles



• Know how to identify customer pain points, desires, objections, motivations and emotional triggers



• Be able to transform those insights into strong creative concepts and ad formats



• Understand how to create powerful hooks that grab attention immediately



• Know how to research competitors using Meta Ads Library, TikTok, social media and other research sources



• Be able to identify winning ads and understand WHY they are working, rather than simply copying them



• Understand current dropshipping creative formats, trends, structures and editing styles



• Have a strong understanding of direct-response marketing and customer psychology



AI VIDEO & IMAGE GENERATION



You must be highly experienced with modern AI creative tools.



We especially value people who know how to use tools such as:



Veo 3 / VO3

Higgsfield

Runway

Kling

Sora

HitFilm

AI Avatar / UGC tools

AI Voiceover tools

AI Image Generation tools



And similar platforms.



You should be able to use AI to create:



• Realistic product videos



• AI-generated UGC



• Realistic models using the product



• Lifestyle scenes



• Product demonstrations



• New environments and backgrounds



• Different customer profiles



• Product-focused images



• Scroll-stopping image ads



• Realistic AI video advertisements



• Custom scenes that would normally require a real photoshoot



• Completely new advertising concepts starting only from basic product assets



You should also have strong experience with AI image generation and image editing.



We don't want someone who only types a basic prompt into an AI tool.



You need to understand how to direct AI creatively and consistently produce realistic, usable and conversion-focused assets.



CREATIVE VISION



This part is extremely important.



We are looking for someone who has creative vision.



If we give you a product, we don't want you to wait for us to tell you exactly what to make.



You should immediately be thinking:



What new angle can we test?



What type of customer can we target?



What desire can we sell?



What problem can we highlight?



What new hook could stop the scroll?



What format haven't competitors tried yet?



Can we recreate this product in a completely different environment using AI?



Can we turn this into UGC?



Can we create a testimonial concept?



Can we create a problem-solution concept?



Can we create a comparison?



Can we create a storytelling ad?



Can we create an entirely new visual format?



We want someone who can constantly bring NEW IDEAS to the team.



Not someone who waits for instructions.



VIDEO EDITING



You must have advanced video editing skills.



You should be able to turn:



Supplier footage

Product images

UGC footage

AI-generated footage

Competitor references

Voiceovers

Basic raw assets



into professional conversion-focused advertisements.



You should understand:



• Fast-paced editing



• Retention



• Pattern interrupts



• Subtitles



• Sound design



• Voiceovers



• Music



• Visual hooks



• B-roll



• Product demonstrations



• Strong CTAs



• Mobile-first editing



• Meta and TikTok creative formats



CREATIVE TESTING



You must understand that we are not looking to create one beautiful ad.



We want to TEST.



From one product, you should be able to create multiple:



HOOKS

ANGLES

CONCEPTS

BODIES

OFFERS

CTAs

VISUALS

VOICEOVERS

CUSTOMER AVATARS

FORMATS



You should know how to take a winning creative and produce new iterations without simply duplicating it.



You should also understand basic performance metrics such as:



CTR

CPC

CPM

CPA

ROAS

Hook Rate

Hold Rate

Conversion Rate



And use performance data to improve the next batch of creatives.



WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR



Someone who only knows how to make videos look beautiful.



Someone who only does cinematic editing.



Someone who only follows scripts.



Someone who needs every hook and angle given to them.



Someone who only copies competitors.



Someone who uses AI without understanding marketing.



Someone who knows editing software but has no creative vision.



We need someone who can:



THINK LIKE A MARKETER

CREATE LIKE A CREATIVE STRATEGIST

EXECUTE LIKE AN EDITOR

USE AI LIKE AN EXPERT



HOW TO APPLY



Send us:



👉 Your 3 BEST dropshipping creatives that YOU personally created



👉 Examples of AI-generated videos or images you have created



👉 The niches you have previously worked with



👉 The AI video and image generation tools you currently use



👉 The editing software you use



👉 A short explanation of how you normally research angles and hooks



👉 Tell us how you would approach creating 5 different angles for the same product



👉 A short explanation of why you think you would be a good fit for this position



Please only apply if you already have real experience creating performance-focused dropshipping creatives.



We are looking for someone who understands products, customers, psychology, angles, hooks, AI, editing and performance marketing — and knows how to combine all of them into creatives that generate sales.



IMPORTANT



If you have read this entire job post, START your application with the word “PEACH” 🍑.



Applications that do not start with “PEACH” will automatically be ignored.



This is simply to make sure you have actually read the full job description before applying.

title: Senior Mobile App Developer — Voice AI / React Native
description:
Senior Mobile App Developer — Voice AI / React Native



HAILU is building a modern rideshare platform and we're looking for an experienced developer to build our Customer Mobile App, including our key differentiator — the HAILU Voice AI Assistant.



The app design and clickable prototype are already completed. We now need someone who can turn it into a production-quality mobile app.



The key challenge — Voice AI



HAILU Assistant is not a chatbot. Customers should be able to book and manage rides naturally by voice, for example:



“HAILU, book me a ride to Sydney Airport tomorrow morning.”



“Actually make that 7.”



“Give me the cheapest driver.”



“I'm at the George Street entrance.”



The Voice AI must support:



Natural conversational voice interaction

Speech-to-text and text-to-speech

Real-time / low-latency conversations

Interruption / barge-in

LLM tool/function calling

Structured outputs and conversational state

Voice + visual + touch synchronisation

Calling HAILU APIs for fares, availability, drivers and bookings

Explicit confirmation before payments/bookings

Authentication and payment guardrails

Idempotency / duplicate-booking protection

Error and failure recovery

The AI never inventing fares, ETAs, availability or payment state

Mobile App



You should also be strong with:



React Native / Expo, TypeScript, APIs, Stripe/payments, Google Maps/location, authentication, push notifications and realtime state.



Experience shipping production iOS/Android apps is important.



When applying



Please send examples of apps you have built and briefly explain your Voice AI / conversational AI experience.



Most importantly, answer:



How would you build a Voice AI Assistant that can modify a live ride booking, call backend tools, handle interruptions and safely complete a payment without allowing the AI to invent transactional information?



Contract | Remote | Sydney timezone preferred | Potential long-term opportunity

title: Digital Creative Services Manager
description:
Location: Hybrid or Remote (depending on location)

Join 4ocean and advance your career while making a significant impact on the environment.



About Us:

4ocean is on a mission to end the ocean plastic crisis and we are looking for passionate, talented people to help us achieve this goal.  We are more than just a brand/company/employer. We are a global movement committed to making a tangible difference in the health of our planet by removing plastic waste from the ocean and coastlines. We also advocate for sustainable change. 

If you are driven by purpose, motivated to contribute to a cause that truly matters, and eager to make a lasting impact on the environment, we want you on our team.



Position Overview:

The Digital Creative Services Manager is a hands-on creative leader responsible for defining and executing the visual identity of our product line content across eCommerce and Wholesale channels blending creative design with marketing strategy. 

Reporting directly to the Managing Director, Product, this role sits at the intersection of brand storytelling, digital marketing, and product presentation. You’ll manage a Graphic Designer and serve as the creative authority on all product content — from the imagery that drives online conversion to the sell sheets and packaging that move product through wholesale partners.

This is a role best suited for someone who thinks strategically, executes precisely, and cares deeply about the mission behind the work.



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Leadership & Strategy

•      Own the creative vision for all product content across eCommerce and Wholesale, ensuring brand consistency and mission alignment at every touchpoint.

•    Owns creative direction across all digital channels: paid social (Meta, TikTok), Amazon, email, DTC site, and any emerging placements. Brand standards don’t drift on this person’s watch.

•    Leads production of both static and video assets, from concept through delivery.

•    Owns creative direction across all digital channels: paid social (Meta, TikTok), Amazon, email, DTC site, and any emerging placements.

•    Act as the operational infrastructure behind the creative. Build and maintain a creative asset library and production workflow, including naming conventions, version control, delivery specs by platform.

•     Partner with the Managing Director, Product to translate business goals into compelling visual narratives.

•     Establish and maintain brand guidelines for product content, photography direction, and digital design standards.

•     Stay ahead of digital design trends, platform algorithm changes, and wholesale presentation best practices.

eCommerce Content

•     Oversee the creation of all product listing assets including primary images, lifestyle photography, infographics, and A+ / enhanced content.

•     Optimize visual content for conversion across owned DTC channels and third-party platforms (e.g., Amazon, retail partner portals).

•     Collaborate with the eCommerce and marketing teams to develop campaign creative, landing pages, and promotional assets.

•     Analyze content performance data and iterate on creative strategy accordingly.

•    Manage multiple concurrent production cycles without dropping handoffs. Product launches, seasonal campaigns, evergreen content, and paid creative tests all run in parallel.



Wholesale Content

•     Develop and maintain a suite of wholesale-facing materials including line sheets, sell sheets, trade show assets, and retail display concepts.

•     Ensure product photography and specifications meet the requirements of key wholesale partners and retail buyers.

•     Support seasonal product launches with tailored wholesale creative packages.

Team Management

•     Directly manage and mentor the Graphic Designer, providing clear briefs, constructive feedback, and professional development support.

•     Build and manage a freelance network (photographers, videographers, editors, etc) as needed for campaign productions.

•     Prioritize and manage the creative workload across projects, balancing quality with speed-to-market.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

•     Work closely with Product, Marketing, and Sales teams to ensure creative assets are aligned with product roadmaps and go-to-market timelines.

•     Partner with the eCommerce team on UX/UI creative decisions that support the online shopping experience.

•     Brief and manage external agencies or production vendors when applicable.

•     Partner directly with paid media to close the feedback loop.

•    Direct internal creators and any external agency or freelance talent. Clear briefing, sharp feedback, no ambiguity about what good looks like.

•    Manages multiple concurrent production cycles without dropping handoffs. Product launches, seasonal campaigns, evergreen content, and paid creative tests all run in parallel.

•    Interface with paid media, organic social, email, and wholesale channels as needed. Cross-functional by default, not by exception.



It’s also important that all 4ocean crew members naturally live and embrace our core values:

● Ocean first

● Get Shit Done!

● Accelerate time

● We’re in this together

● Nudge don’t judge

● Stay stoked

● Think bigger!



Qualifications:

Required

•     Minimum 5 years of experience in digital creative, brand design, or content production, with at least 2 years in a management or lead role.

•     Demonstrated experience creating product content for eCommerce platforms (DTC and/or marketplace).

•     Strong portfolio showcasing product photography direction, digital design, and brand-consistent visual storytelling.

•     Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and familiarity with Figma or similar tools.

•     Experience briefing and directing photographers, videographers, or other creative vendors.

•     Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

•     Knows the difference between a scroll-stopping hook frame and a pretty image that converts nobody.

•     Brand standards don’t drift on your watch.

•    You’re not a passenger on the analytics side. You read performance data (ie. CTR, hook rate, thumb-stop, ROAS by creative) and act on it.

•    Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, After Effects) and Figma. Working fluency in generative AI tools (Midjourney, Firefly, or equivalent) is not optional. PXM software is a plus.

•    You understand the authenticity of mission-first content architecture.

Preferred

•      Background in consumer goods, sustainability, outdoor, or lifestyle brands.

•      Experience with Shopify or similar eCommerce platforms.

•      Familiarity with retail buyer presentation formats and wholesale portal requirements.

•      Passion for ocean conservation or environmental causes.

title: Executive Assistant to the Founder - (20 hours a week), $1k+/month
description:
I'm George, founder of a DTC pet supplement brand that went from zero to 7 figures in under a year and is on track for 8 figures. The business is growing faster than I can keep it organized, and the small stuff is eating my days. I need one person who takes it all off my plate and runs it better than I would.



This is not a VA job where you wait for tasks. You'll be my right hand: the business first, my personal admin too.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



1. Systems and organization (your #1 priority from day one)

- Build our Notion workspace (and ClickUp where it fits): team wiki, SOPs, project boards, templates.

- Move our Google Docs into Notion, formatted, structured and linked, so anyone on the team finds anything in seconds.

- One page per team member: role, contract, SOPs, tools, onboarding.

- Keep Google Drive clean: clear folders, consistent file names, no more "Untitled document".



2. Inbox, messages and follow-ups

- Go through my
 and messages every day: flag what needs me, draft the replies, clear the rest.

- Track what I owe people and what they owe me. Remind me before anything is late.



3. Calendar

- Run my Google Calendar: calls, invites, clashes, reminders, and the links I need in every event.



4. Personal admin (a big part of the job)

- Apartments, travel, purchases, appointments, deliveries. Whatever it is, you research it, bring me one clear recommendation and see it through to done.



WHERE THIS GOES

You start part-time as my executive assistant. As we scale, the role grows into full-time operations and chief of staff.



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU

- Have 2+ years as an executive or personal assistant to a founder or CEO, or in operations.

- Have built systems from scratch in Notion or ClickUp (databases, relations, templates), not just used them.

- Are obsessed with detail. Messy folders and sloppy formatting bother you.

- Write clear, natural English and don't need step-by-step instructions.

- Notice what's about to slip before anyone asks. When you say done, it's done.

- Keep private things private.

- Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) to work faster.

- Can work your 20 hours between 3 PM and 11 PM Manila time (I'm in Europe), and reply fast on Slack and WhatsApp.



PAY AND TERMS

- $1,000+ per month for 20 hours a week, depending on experience.

- One-month paid trial at the full rate, then long-term.



HOW TO APPLY

Detail is the job, so this is your first test. Send all five:

1. Subject line, exactly: EA - Your Full Name - Your Monthly Rate in USD

2. A link or screenshots of a Notion or ClickUp system you built (blur anything private), plus 2 sentences on what it fixed.

3. A 1-2 minute Loom: who you are, who you've assisted, and what you're best at.

4. It's Monday, 9 AM. Overnight I got: an
 from our lawyer needing my signature by Wednesday, a WhatsApp from an editor about an unpaid invoice, an interview booked on top of a team call this afternoon, and a flight confirmation for Friday with my name spelled wrong. What do you do, and in what order? 5 lines max.

5. Your earliest start date, and whether you work for anyone else right now.



Applications missing any of the five are skipped.

The reference is Hua & Jin: a grandmother-and-granddaughter duo presenting wellness-themed stories and visual demonstrations in familiar home settings, with expressive delivery and on-screen subtitles. We want that level of character consistency and believable execution for our own original AI personas and visual identity.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



1. CONTENT IDEAS AND WRITING



• Research the audience, relevant topics, successful formats, and trends to develop original content ideas.

• Build and maintain a content calendar with recurring series and a consistent publishing schedule.

• Write hooks, English scripts, character dialogue, captions, and calls to action that feel natural to a US audience.

• Develop the characters’ personalities and tone of voice with our team, then keep them consistent across posts.

• Take initiative with new ideas and turn broad creative direction into complete content without needing a supplied script for every video.



2. AI PRODUCTION AND EDITING



• Create original, realistic AI characters and maintain consistent faces, appearance, voices, and personalities across videos.

• Produce talking-head scenes, conversations between recurring characters, and visual demonstrations in everyday settings.

• Generate natural English voices, accurate lip sync, and supporting scenes that clearly match the script.

• Edit engaging vertical Reels with strong openings, subtitles, clear storytelling, sound, and pacing.

• Fix changing faces, distorted hands or objects, unnatural movement, and inconsistent scenes.

• Create cover frames and keep source files, prompts, character references, and voice settings organized.



3. PUBLISHING AND IMPROVEMENT



• Upload, schedule, and publish Reels, supporting posts, and Stories on the account, including captions and cover images.

• Check each post’s visuals, audio, spelling, and formatting before it goes live.

• Manage the publishing calendar and follow through on agreed content plans.

• Review reach, watch time, audience retention, saves, shares, and follower growth.

• Use results and audience comments to improve hooks, topics, formats, and future episodes, and share clear recommendations with our team.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Proven experience creating realistic AI people and finished AI videos, with examples of consistent characters across multiple scenes or posts.

• Strong English writing skills and a feel for natural US dialogue and short-form storytelling.

• Experience planning content and publishing or managing an Instagram or similar social media account.

• A practical workflow for character consistency, image-to-video generation, voice production, and lip sync.

• Strong video editing skills, attention to detail, and the ability to interpret content performance.

• Someone who takes ownership, proposes ideas, solves problems, and follows through independently.



Use the tools you know best. Show us the results and explain your process.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



A recognizable AI personality, original content published consistently, believable characters and dialogue, and a clear learning loop that makes each new batch stronger. You own the process from content planning through writing, production, and posting.



WORK SETUP



Remote, part-time collaboration: 20 hours per week.

Compensation: negotiable based on experience and portfolio.

You work with our team on overall direction and independently handle content creation and day-to-day publishing.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject “AI INFLUENCER – CONTENT OWNER” and include:



1. Three relevant content examples, including AI videos showing a consistent character across scenes or posts. Explain what you personally handled: ideas, writing, production, editing, and/or publishing.

2. An account you have helped manage, your responsibilities, and any results you can substantiate. If the work is confidential, describe your contribution instead.

3. A short Loom introduction in English. Walk us through how you would take an idea from research and script to AI production, posting, and performance review, including the tools you use.

4. One original Reel idea for two recurring AI characters, plus the opening hook you would write for a US audience.

5. Your availability for 20 hours per week, expected rate in USD, and potential start date.



We’re looking for someone who can build a recognizable AI personality into an engaging, consistently managed social media account.

description:
WE’RE LOOKING FOR AN A-PLAYER CREATIVE STRATEGIST - NOT A DESIGNER



We’re looking for an A-player Creative Strategist with proven e-commerce experience.



You should have already worked with multiple e-commerce/DTC brands and understand what it takes to develop ad creatives that perform on platforms like Meta and TikTok.



This is not an entry-level role. We’re looking for someone who can come in, understand the customer and product quickly, and independently identify what we should test next - and why.



YOU UNDERSTAND



* Customer psychology and buying behavior

* Direct response marketing

* Why certain ads convert and others don't

* How to turn customer research into strong angles and hooks

* How to develop creatives specifically for e-commerce brands

* What makes paid social creatives perform on Meta and TikTok



WHAT YOU’LL DO



You will:



* Research customers through reviews, Reddit, competitor ads, comments, forums, and other sources

* Identify pain points, desires, objections, awareness levels, and buying triggers

* Turn research into new ad angles, hooks, concepts, and hypotheses

* Create clear, actionable creative briefs for our video editors and designers

* Analyze what's working and develop iterations based on winning concepts

* Work closely with our media buyer to d
 what gets tested next

* Continuously look for new creative opportunities that can improve performance



You will not be responsible for editing videos or designing ads yourself.



Your responsibility is the strategy and thinking behind the creatives.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You could come from a background as a:



* Creative Strategist

* Direct Response Copywriter

* DTC/E-commerce Ad Strategist

* Performance Marketer

* Media Buyer who moved toward the creative side

* UGC Strategist



Your exact title doesn't matter.



Your track record does.



E-COMMERCE EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



This is important:



You must have previous experience working with e-commerce/DTC brands.



Ideally, you've worked with multiple stores and have been directly involved in developing creatives for paid acquisition.



You should be able to show examples of:



* E-commerce brands you've worked with

* Ad angles or concepts you've developed

* Creative strategies you've contributed to

* Winning ads or concepts that came from your research/strategy

* How you think about finding and scaling winning creative



We're specifically looking for someone who already understands the e-commerce advertising environment.



We are not looking to teach someone e-commerce creative strategy from scratch.



COMPENSATION & PERFORMANCE BONUSES



The base rate for this position is $3-$6 USD per hour, depending on your experience, skill level, and track record.



But we don't want your earnings to stop at your hourly rate.



We strongly believe in rewarding performance.



If your creative strategies, angles, and concepts contribute to winning ads and help us scale, we are happy to pay additional performance-based bonuses on top of your hourly rate.



The better you perform and the more value you bring to the business, the more you can earn.



We want to build a long-term relationship with an A-player, and we're happy to financially reward people who consistently produce results.



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT MOST



We don't care about fancy titles.



We care about whether you can:



* Find insights other people miss

* Understand why customers actually buy

* Turn research into compelling angles

* Develop ideas that are worth spending money to test

* Learn from performance data and improve the next batch of creatives

* Think independently instead of waiting to be told what to test



We're looking for someone who takes ownership of creative performance.



An A-player who constantly asks:



"What should we test next, and why will it work?"



HOW TO APPLY



Please send us:



* A short summary of your e-commerce experience

* Examples of ads/briefs you've worked on, if available

* A short explanation of why you believed those concepts would convert

* Your weekly availability



Please only apply if you already have hands-on experience developing paid ad creatives for e-commerce brands.

s.

title: Indie Game Marketing & Community Assistant

* Creating marketing content for the game

* Creating short-form videos/Reels/TikToks/Shorts from existing game content

* Managing and growing our Reddit presence

* Helping with Discord and community engagement

* Finding practical ways to attract new players

* Supporting small paid advertising campaigns

* Helping plan social media and content campaigns

* Responding to basic player support/helpdesk tickets

* Collecting player feedback and identifying common issues

* Promoting in-game events and updates



You won’t need to do everything immediately. We’ll start with a small amount of work and expand the role based on your strengths.

Ideally you have experience with some of the following:



* Gaming or indie-game marketing

* Managing gaming communities

* Reddit and Discord

* TikTok, Reels or YouTube Shorts

* Video editing using CapCut, Premiere or similar

* Social media growth

* Paid ads / Meta Ads

* Customer or player support

* Gaming content creation

* Influencer or creator outreach



You should also:



* Have strong written English

* Be comfortable learning an existing online game

* Be able to work independently

* Have good judgment when communicating with players

* Be proactive and suggest ideas rather than needing constant instructions



## Hours & Pay



Initially around **5–10 hours per week**.



Budget is approximately **$5–$10 USD/hour**, depending on experience and ability.



There will be a **paid trial** before we commit to ongoing work.



If things go well, there is potential for more responsibility and additional hours.



## How to apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Examples of gaming-related work you’ve done

3. Examples of social media posts or videos you’ve created

4. Any experience growing a game, gaming brand, Discord, Reddit community, YouTube/TikTok account, etc.

5. Your experience with Reddit and Discord

6. Your hourly rate

7. One quick idea you would try to bring new players to an established online RPG



Please **do not send a generic VA application**. Gaming experience and an understanding of online communities are important for this role.



If you’ve worked directly with an indie game, gaming studio, esports company, gaming creator, or live online game, please mention that near the top of your application.

title: AI UGC Content Creator
description:
Do you love putting together ideas or concepts using AI in the most realistic way? Are you passionate about AI creating and want to ascend to the highest level? You have already created viral AI videos and you know that a great video comes from great inputs. You know how to make any content look natural, authentic and realistic. You are a driven person who turns scripts into reality with AI generation tools, and you love to analyze your generations to see what you can improve.



You will get to work with passionate and driven creators who excel at what they do. You will be a part of a culture where everyone likes to help each other, gives honest feedback to each other and strives to be their best. You will make new friends, have fun, and be around people who are serious about what they do. You will get to learn from courses, videos, and other sources that will help you grow and improve your AI creation and how to apply it to your content the best way.

- We create and turn organic AI content ideas into videos, for social media platforms that helps brands increase their revenue

- We believe in every member of our team and make it the highest priority to ensure everyone has what they need to make their content successful

- we break down content and provide honest feedback to make each of us learn, improve and grow



Who we are looking for



- A content creator with a deep understanding of AI content creation and a strong feel for realism

- An individual who is driven, competitive, and passionate about AI content

- Someone who loves to turn scripts and ideas into finished videos with AI on a continual basis



Your role

Things that should resonate with you



- You already have a great amount of experience with creating AI content on a daily basis

- You have already generated a significant amount of views with content created by AI

- When you watch an AI video, you can instantly tell what breaks the realism and how to fix it



What we expect from you



- You have a deep understanding of AI UGC and AI realism. You know how "real" looks like, how physics behaves on camera, and you apply it directly to your generations

- Image generation is very close to you. You know how to generate authentic and realistic images with Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2.0, Seedream, or other up-to-date image models

- You have already generated AI UGC content with Omni, Kling 3.0, and Seedance 2.5. You possess high level prompting skills and understand video generation to its core

- You know that the quality of the output is decided by the quality of the inputs, and you take your time with references, frames and prompts

- You can edit your generations into a flawless final video from start to end

- You take ownership of your work, and you are not afraid of new challenges

- You love learning new things, and you have a strong desire to prove yourself you can be even better at what you do

- You speak English fluently, and you use it and understand it at a high level



We are here to push the limits with organic AI content while helping clients reach new heights. Everyone here is serious and loves to create content with AI. We respect each other, help each other, and grow together while having fun in the process. There are no egoistic people here, only humble ones. If you feel like this deeply resonates with you and you are ready to make a long-term change in your life, please send us your resumé and a cover letter in which we want you to tell us why you should be the one for this position and your accomplishments. ABOUT US

We're a US-based (Michigan) Amazon wholesale seller. We buy direct from brands

and authorized distributors and sell FBA. We're building out our supplier pipeline and need someone to own the front end of it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build our distributor and brand pipeline inside our sourcing platform  (Third-Party Profits) — research, screen, and log complete supplier records

- Send outreach emails to US distributors and brands to open wholesale accounts

- Handle the standard objections ("we don't sell to Amazon sellers," "no e-commerce") and push applications through to approval

- Get line sheets and price lists, load them into the platform, and run scans

- Identify profitable products we're cleared to sell and build purchase orders for the owner to approve

- Track everything daily in the platform and a shared Google Sheet



SCHEDULE

Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:00pm US Eastern = 9:00pm-5:00am Manila.

This is a night shift. Please only apply if you can commit to it long term.



REQUIREMENTS

- 1+ year as an Amazon VA, wholesale sourcing strongly preferred

- Excellent written English — you'll email US brand reps without me editing it

- Clear spoken English — this role includes phone calls to US distributors

- Strong Google Sheets/Excel: VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP, pivot tables, text-to-columns, and you know why a UPC has to be stored as text

- You understand FBA fees: referral, fulfillment by size tier, storage, inbound placement

- Comfortable with Keepa and/or SellerAmp — sales rank, offer count, Buy Box

- You know what a line sheet, case pack, inner pack, MOQ and net-30 are

- Reliable internet plus a backup connection, backup power, and a quiet space for calls

- Your own computer and headset



NICE TO HAVE

- You've used Third-Party Profits, SmartScout, or Tactical Arbitrage

- You've personally opened wholesale accounts with US brands or distributors

- Experience getting brands ungated legitimately



PLEASE DON'T APPLY IF

- You offer "ungating services" or guarantee brand approvals

- You sell on Amazon yourself or want to source alongside us

- You'd need our account login rather than a secondary user invite



PAY

Starts with a paid 5-day trial project. Strong performers move to a full-time monthly role with a night-shift premium, semi-monthly pay via Wise or Payoneer, and a 13th-month bonus.



HOW TO APPLY

Send me:

1. The word CASEPACK in your subject line

2. Three sentences: a wholesale account you helped open, and how you found that supplier

3. Two or three sentences answering this — what's the difference between a distributor account and a brand-direct account, and which would you approach first for a new seller, and why?

4. A link to a 2-minute recording of yourself introducing your experience  (Loom, Google Drive, anything)

5. Your internet speed and whether you have backup power



Applications missing any of the five won't be reviewed.

I

nfluencer Outreach

s with a direct CTA/link
